The Junior Customer Success Manager keeps single-store restaurants live, transacting and growing on SIDES. Du wirst echte Nutzerprobleme auf Grundlage qualitativer und quantitativer Daten herausarbeiten, eine Einschätzung dazu entwickeln, was sich ändern sollte, das passende Experiment aufsetzen und die Ergebnisse selbst analysieren.

Du schließt dich einer Gruppe von Conversion Analysts im Unternehmen an, die genauso arbeiten, und bringst eine Perspektive und Erfahrung mit, von der das gesamte Team lernen wird.

Unser Produkt ist ausschließlich für den deutschsprachigen Markt. Um unsere Nutzer:innen wirklich zu verstehen und für sie zu gestalten, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse unerlässlich. Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im Team sind ebenfalls erforderlich.

Das wirst du konkret tun:

  • Das eigentliche Problem identifizieren, bevor du es löst. In quantitative und qualitative Daten eintauchen, bis du die wirkliche Frage hinter dem Auftrag findest. Sie dann verständlich und handlungsleitend machen. Ein gut formuliertes Problem ist die halbe Lösung.
  • Das Experiment aufsetzen, ehrlich lesen und entscheiden, was als nächstes kommt. Eine testbare Veränderung definieren, sie sauber instrumentieren und das Ergebnis analysieren. Dann das Gelernte nutzen, um die nächste Frage zu formulieren. Das schließt ein, auch über Tests zu berichten, die nicht funktioniert haben, und den nächsten Schritt zu gestalten.
  • KI einsetzen und dein Urteil dort einbringen, wo es zählt. KI unterstützt viele unserer ersten Entwürfe. Du wirst sie briefen, hinterfragen und die Qualität sichern – damit deine eigene Zeit für das Denken bleibt, das ein Modell nicht leisten kann.
  • Für das Weglassen argumentieren. Hinzufügen ist einfach. Du wirst mitentscheiden, was seinen Platz verdient und was entfernt werden sollte – und bereit sein, dafür einzustehen.
  • Mit Nachbar:innen sprechen. Experimente sagen dir, was passiert ist – nicht, was Menschen gebraucht hätten. Du wirst echte Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen, die das Produkt nutzen, weil man sich kein Verständnis für andere durch A/B-Tests erarbeiten kann.
  • Erfahrungen gestalten, die auf echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und echtem Nachbarschaftsleben basieren. Dein Job ist es, zu Flows und Screens beizutragen, die intuitiv nutzbar sind und ihren Platz durch messbaren Mehrwert rechtfertigen.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast einen ausgeprägten Produktsinn und arbeitest datengetrieben. Dein Hintergrund kann verschieden sein – Product Analytics, CRO, Growth Engineering, oder eine hybridere Rolle aus Produkt oder Design – solange du weißt, wie man Hypothesen schärft, Experimente aufsetzt und Ergebnisse in Entscheidungen übersetzt.
  • Du hast Experimente von Anfang bis Ende durchgeführt und weißt, wie du von einem zum nächsten kommst: Hypothese aufstellen, starke Varianten entwickeln, die richtigen Metriken festlegen, Ergebnisse analysieren und eine klare Entscheidung treffen – launchen, verwerfen oder iterieren.
  • Du hast technisches Know-how und Erfahrung im Aufsetzen und Auswerten von Experimenten in einem A/B-Testing-Tool sowie im Erstellen der dafür notwendigen Dashboards.
  • Du holst dir deine Zahlen selbst per SQL-Abfrage. Du arbeitest mit Rohdaten, um Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und Chancen zu identifizieren – ohne auf andere warten zu müssen.
  • Du hast statistische Grundkenntnisse. Du musst kein R beherrschen, aber du verstehst, worum es bei Bayesianischer vs. frequentistischer Statistik geht und warum man vor dem Start eines Experiments eine Power-Analyse durchführt.
  • Du präsentierst deine Arbeit klar, verteidigst deine Entscheidungen, wenn sie hinterfragt werden, und bist sicher vor einem Publikum.
  • Du arbeitest routiniert mit KI-Tools. Diese Rolle gibt dir mehr Einfluss und Kontrolle – aber dafür musst du unseren AI-Enablement-Stack nutzen und weiterentwickeln können.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich – du wirst Texte und Flows für deutschsprachige Nutzer:innen gestalten und bewerten.
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im internationalen Team.

Bitte schick uns ein Anschreiben, in dem du erklärst, warum diese Rolle und warum jetzt – und beschreibe mindestens ein Projekt, das du von Anfang bis Ende erläuterst: die Hypothese, was du getestet hast, das Ergebnis und was du daraus mitgenommen hast. Zeig uns, wie du Daten genutzt hast, um dein Denken voranzubringen, und wo Experimente das beeinflusst haben, was du gebaut hast.

title: Social Media & Project Coordination (m/f/d), Fashion Week Focus
description:
About us
Fashion Revolution Germany e.V. is the German chapter of Fashion Revolution, the global movement for a clean, safe, fair, transparent and accountable fashion industry. Since the Rana Plaza factory collapse in 2013, the movement has asked one question: Who made my clothes? As a non-profit association of designers, educators, communicators and activists, we run campaigns, workshops and events that make fashion’s social and environmental impacts visible and show practical alternatives such as repair, upcycling and circular models.

The project: RE/CLAIMED at Berlin Fashion Week
A key focus of this internship is RE/CLAIMED, a multidisciplinary sustainable fashion show supported by Fashion Revolution Germany. RE/CLAIMED combines upcycled runway looks, dance, live performance, music and interactive installations to change how people value their clothes. After a sold-out first edition in January 2026, the second edition will take place with around 400 guests expected.

Your role
You’ll pilot the day-to-day social media activities for RE/CLAIMED in the run-up to Berlin Fashion Week, during the show and in the follow-up. You’ll also support the coordination of the show and of Fashion Revolution Germany’s projects in Berlin. You’ll work directly with Eric Vincent Vinsonneau, who leads RE/CLAIMED, and alongside our communications partners.

Beyond RE/CLAIMED, you’ll take part in other Fashion Revolution Germany activities in Berlin. One example is our stand at the Alt-Rixdorfer Christmas Market in Neukölln on the weekend of 4–6 December 2026, where you’ll help with preparation, on-site support and social media coverage.

Your tasks

Social media (main focus)

  • Plan and manage the content calendar for RE/CLAIMED’s Instagram, and optionally build a TikTok presence

  • Create posts, stories and reels: behind the scenes, designer and performer portraits, countdowns and impact facts

  • Cover the show live and produce recap content afterwards

title: ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops)
description:
StellDirVor is an independent consulting, trade and technology company specializing in immersive technologies for healthcare. We support organizations in implementing digital innovations — Virtual, Augmented and Mixed Reality as well as AI — particularly for learning, training and real-time assistance in clinical and care environments. By combining technology and healthcare, we help optimize processes, improve knowledge transfer and enhance quality of care.

Supported by a Germany (ZIM) and Taiwanese (GIPIP) partnership grant, we are currently developing ARAIAS — an AR- and AI-based hands-free training and assistance system for chronic wound care. Using AR smart glasses, the system enables 3D capture, AI-supported analysis, and standardized remote expertise and documentation directly at the point of care.

As our ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops), you will build the AI capabilities at the core of ARAIAS: evaluating and fine-tuning computer vision models on smart glasses data, running the ML operations behind them, and applying generative AI to create synthetic medical images for education. We're at an early stage — moving from concept to working prototype — so the near-term focus is on validating models and building toward a proof of concept we can test in real education and clinical settings.

As part of a small team, you will own the full data lifecycle end to end — from sourcing, consent and annotation to preparation — alongside model development and deployment.

We welcome candidates at different experience levels. What matters most is a solid ML foundation and genuine awareness of the medical imaging domain.

Notes:

Due to the nature of the project, we can only consider candidates who are already residing in Germany.

Tasks

  • Select and benchmark pre-trained models and/or validated architectures for medical image analysis and adapt them to domain-specific data, ensuring robust performance under real-world conditions

  • Identify and adapt suitable generative AI models to create realistic synthetic medical images for education and training

  • Evaluate and fine-tune small language models (SLMs) for voice interaction — speech-to-text, intent understanding and text-to-speech — optimized for low-latency or on-device use with smart glasses

  • Research and assess state-of-the-art ML models and emerging trends, including Explainable AI (XAI), cybersecurity for ML, and deployment and distribution modes (edge vs. cloud, federated learning, model compression)

  • Plan and execute the ML operations pipeline — data gathering, annotation, preparation, training, testing and deployment

  • Propose a data collection strategy — research suitable public and clinical data sources, recommend patient consent and other administrative requirements for ML training (e.g., data protection agreements, ethics approval), and define collection and annotation protocols with clinical experts, including labeling guidelines and quality checks

  • Identify and validate factors that affect model performance — image conditions, dataset bias, patient diversity, data privacy and regulatory requirements

  • Define test strategies and metrics, and validate model outputs against clinician assessments

  • Perform build vs. buy analyses for models, tools and services, including cost comparison

  • Estimate compute and training costs and propose budgets for model training and deployment

  • Choose and set up training environments flexibly — local hardware or cloud — based on cost, data privacy and performance

  • Make pragmatic technical decisions appropriate for the current prototyping stage and document results clearly

  • Maintain clear, traceable documentation of data sources, models, experiments and design decisions to support audits and quality reviews

  • Evaluate and integrate additional sensors where feasible (e.g., depth, LiDAR, thermal, multispectral) and fuse them with RGB input

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics or a related field — or equivalent practical background

  • Strong Python skills and hands-on use of PyTorch, OpenCV or TensorFlow

  • Solid understanding of computer vision — classification, object detection and image segmentation, 3D Reconstruction and Multi-View Geometry

  • Hands-on knowledge of transfer learning — adapting pre-trained models and fine-tuning them on custom datasets

  • Working knowledge of the full ML lifecycle — data preparation, training, evaluation and deployment

  • Basic knowledge of generative models (diffusion models or GANs) and common open-source libraries

  • Comfortable training models both locally (GPU workstation) and on cloud platforms

  • Able to estimate ML compute costs and compare build vs. buy options to support budget decisions

  • Awareness of medical imaging challenges — limited data, label variability between clinicians and class imbalance

  • Awareness of healthcare data privacy and ethics (e.g., GDPR, patient consent, anonymization) and why explainability and bias matter in clinical AI

  • Able to read research papers and apply them pragmatically

  • Self-directed and pragmatic — able to take initiative and own problems end-to-end in a lean team

  • Fluent in English — German is a bonus

Strong Plus

  • Projects or coursework in medical imaging or clinical AI

  • Familiarity with semi-supervised learning — leveraging limited or partially labeled data

  • Experience with 3D data processing — depth maps, point clouds or mesh reconstruction

  • Exposure to multi-modal learning — combining RGB and depth or LiDAR data

  • Edge AI or wearable deployment (e.g., TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, model quantization)

  • Knowledge of explainability methods (e.g., Grad-CAM, SHAP) or adversarial robustness

  • Familiarity with MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC, Docker)

  • Awareness of medical device regulation for AI software (e.g., EU MDR, IEC 62304)

  • Familiarity with small language models (SLMs) and speech pipelines (e.g., Whisper, on-device speech recognition and text-to-speech)

Benefits

  • Meaningful work — You help shape how technology redefines education and training in healthcare, with real impact on clinical outcomes

  • Ownership and creative freedom — You work autonomously, contribute your ideas directly, and have a genuine say in how the system is built

  • A learning culture — We support personal and professional growth through knowledge sharing, access to innovative tools and methods, and a dedicated learning budget

  • Flexible working — Remote-friendly setup with the option to work from our Munich office

  • Flat hierarchies and team spirit — A small, open, and trust-based team where communication is direct and everyone's voice matters

  • International collaboration — Work alongside a Taiwan-based partner covering technology, hardware and research

Applications are accepted only through our application form. Applications sent by email or through other channels will not be considered.

We are only able to respond to candidates selected for further consideration. If you have not heard from us within four weeks of applying, please consider your application unsuccessful at this time.

Following our recent acquisition and rebranding, your role now encompasses our fully integrated Travel and Spend ecosystem. You will be responsible for a portfolio of large SMB accounts within the DACH market, helping them streamline not just their travel, but their entire expense management workflow. What You Will Do:

  • Portfolio Management: Own a portfolio of large SMB customers and develop a high level of customer engagement with influential users (Admins, Finance Directors, Travel Managers) within those accounts.

  • Strategic Consultation: Gain a deep understanding of your customers' business and show you understand and identify with their goals as an organization.   • Excellent analytical abilities with fluency in Excel and data interpretation.

  • Solid analytical background to help clients visualise their T&E ROI.

  • Feedback-Oriented: You view constructive feedback as a tool for growth, seeking input early, iterating fast, and sharing honest perspectives with your team.

  • A Strategic Client Partner: You naturally empathize with the financial and operational challenges our clients face, using those insights to build lasting, high-trust partnerships.

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

 

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst, you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own and continuously improve our characterization analysis software suite

  • Develop new analysis methods as experiments and measurement capabilities evolve

  • Handle large measurement datasets spanning electrical, optical, and electro-optical characterization

  • Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of analysis outputs

  • Turn raw measurement data into actionable insights for process and design decisions

  • Extract device parameters from measured data and benchmark results against physical and compact models

  • Perform statistical process and yield analyses to identify trends, correlations, and outliers across wafers and lots

  • Correlate characterization results with process parameters, closing the loop between measurement and process control

  • Integrate analysis outputs with fab MES and data systems to enable real-time process feedback

  • Define standardized analysis protocols and transition mature R&D code into robust, production-ready tools

  • Optimize analysis pipelines for throughput and scalability as we move toward high-volume production

Your Qualifications

  • An M.S. or PhD in Data Science, Physics, or another relevant technical discipline

  • At least two years of relevant industry or research experience; a related PhD project

  • Strong Python skills and a genuine passion for building high-quality software

  • A proven track record of designing, developing, and owning a software pipeline or technical project end-to-end

  • A solid foundation in device physics, including solid-state physics, semiconductor devices, and photonics

  • Experience with statistical analysis, model fitting, and parameter extraction

  • Experience with data visualization and tracking trends across wafers, lots, or manufacturing processes

  • The ability to work with laboratory or fab instrument interfaces

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.


🛠️ About our Driving Product Team

The Driving Product team owns Wayve's core end to end driving model, the algorithm that directly shapes how our vehicles behave on the road. This model already underpins production agreements with Nissan and Mercedes, with further OEM partnerships in the works, so the team's output is tied directly to Wayve's near term commercial milestones. The team is highly iterative: it looks at the top issues we see on the road, root causes them, and drives them out through data, model and evaluation changes, working closely with other teams across the business to resolve issues that span the model and vehicle interface.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Lead the team iterating on L2 driving performance, balancing hands-on technical work with team leadership

  • Diagnose the highest impact issues seen on the road, root cause them, and resolve them through data and model iteration

  • Own changes to data recipes, model architecture, evaluation and release readiness for the driving model

  • Partner with other teams to resolve cross-functional issues, including model and vehicle interface problems

  • Act as one of the team's key hands-on developers, writing code and running experiments alongside directing the team's priorities

🧩 What you'll be working on:

  • The end to end driving model that powers Wayve's L2 product and sits at the centre of our OEM partnerships with Nissan and Mercedes, with further partners in the pipeline

  • Scaling the driving model's performance across different geographies and vehicle platforms while hitting performance and compliance KPIs

  • Data led iteration cycles: using on road and off road evaluation to identify the biggest performance gaps and close them

  • Cross-functional resolution of model and vehicle interface issues, working with specialists across the business

  • Growing and shaping a small, high impact team (initially up to five people) as the driving model programme scales

👤 You should apply if:

  • You're highly technical and hands-on, comfortable writing Python and doing model and data iteration yourself, not just directing others

  • You've delivered deployed, production ML models, ideally in robotics or autonomous vehicles, with experience shipping and iterating on ML for embodied AI applications

  • Alternatively, you've productionised ML models at another company and have experience delivering incremental improvements to a live system over time

  • Your experience is production focused rather than primarily research or early stage exploration

  • You want to keep doing deeply technical work, whether or not you've managed people before. We're looking for strong ICs or tech leads just as much as experienced managers, and are happy to ease the right person into managing a small team

🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚗 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve's mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

📋 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (20 mins)

  • Competency technical interviews (programming and system design; 2 hours)

  • Deep-dive interviews (domain and technical leadership; 2 hours)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

We'll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What's in it for you (Location dependent):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partner discounts and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

title: Accountant (m/f/d)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accountant (m/f/d) based in France.

As an Accountant, you will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the accounting operations of German entities within an international software group. You will oversee day-to-day accounting activities, contribute to month-end and year-end closing processes, and ensure compliance with German accounting standards and tax regulations. Working closely with the finance team, external tax advisors, and payroll providers, you will help deliver reliable financial reporting and maintain strong internal controls. You will also contribute to budgeting, variance analysis, and financial performance monitoring to support informed business decisions. This fully remote opportunity offers a hands-on environment where you can improve existing processes, bring structure to financial operations, and take ownership of meaningful responsibilities. It is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented accounting professional seeking to grow within an international, entrepreneurial, and collaborative team.


Accountabilities:
  • Manage day-to-day accounting activities for German legal entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial records.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing procedures, including journal entries, accounting adjustments, and financial analysis.
  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and support the review of account balances to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Follow up with vendors regarding missing invoices, prepare cost accruals, and contribute to profit and loss (P&L) reviews.
  • Process supplier payments and bank transfers, ensuring that the appropriate approvals and internal procedures are followed.
  • Reconcile intercompany transactions and investigate discrepancies to maintain consistent financial records across entities.
  • Prepare German VAT filings, including Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung and Zusammenfassende Meldung, and support payroll tax declarations (Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung) in collaboration with external payroll providers and tax advisors.
  • Assist with the preparation of annual financial statements in accordance with German Commercial Code (HGB) requirements, as well as statutory audits and tax filings.
  • Maintain and strengthen internal financial controls, accounting procedures, and compliance practices.
  • Review and improve existing accounting processes, resolve outstanding items, clean up historical ledger discrepancies, and establish more efficient financial workflows.
  • Prepare financial KPIs and management reports, validating data accuracy and consistency before submission.
  • Support monthly variance analysis by comparing actual results against budgets and forecasts, investigating discrepancies, and providing relevant insights.
  • Collaborate with the wider finance team on daily accounting operations, reporting activities, process improvements, and special projects.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of professional accounting experience, including hands-on responsibility for German accounting practices under HGB and German tax requirements.
  • Experience in the software, technology, or Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) industry.
  • Solid understanding of accrual accounting, financial reconciliations, journal entries, closing procedures, and financial reporting.
  • Practical knowledge of German VAT requirements and familiarity with payroll tax declarations and statutory reporting obligations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with the ability to work confidently with financial data and accounting reports.
  • Experience with NetSuite or similar accounting and enterprise resource planning systems is an advantage.
  • Experience managing multiple legal entities or multi-currency accounting is a plus.
  • A professional qualification in accounting, bookkeeping, or a related discipline is desirable.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and reliability, with a commitment to maintaining high standards in financial documentation and reporting.
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset and willingness to resolve historical accounting issues, organize incomplete records, and improve existing processes.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and take ownership of responsibilities in a fully remote environment.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate proactively with colleagues, external advisors, and service providers across remote teams.
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn new systems, expand responsibilities, and develop professionally over time.
  • Fluency in both German and English, written and spoken.
  • Residence in Europe and legal authorization to work in the country of residence. Being based in or near Berlin is an advantage.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement: Work remotely from an eligible location within Europe.
  • International working environment: Collaborate with finance professionals and stakeholders across an international software group.
  • Entrepreneurial team culture: Benefit from a hands-on environment that encourages ownership, initiative, and practical problem-solving.

  • Meaningful responsibilities: Take ownership of day-to-day accounting activities and contribute directly to the accuracy and efficiency of financial operations.

title: Junior Data & Automation Engineer
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The Data & Automations Team

The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability.

The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions.

Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver.

The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

Role

As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams.

You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written.

Tech environment

Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work.

You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Under the supervision of the Data & Automations team's more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.

Data Platform & Infrastructure:

  • Develop and maintain ingestion pipelines from APIs, databases, and SaaS tools, using Fivetran, Airflow, and Python
  • Build and maintain dbt models that turn raw data into clean, documented, and tested datasets
  • Contribute to the evolution of our orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code setup
  • Help improve data quality, observability, and alerting across the platform

G&A and GTM Data Pipelines & Automations:

  • Build pipelines and integrations that sync data between business systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS) through our data warehouse, including reverse ETL with Hightouch
  • Develop Python-based automations that remove manual work for teams such as Finance, People, IT, and Customer Success
  • Prepare reliable datasets for reporting and for the Pigment applications used by business teams

AI Projects:

  • Contribute to AI-powered solutions, such as LLM pipelines that extract, classify, and enrich unstructured data (call transcripts, messages, tickets)
  • Build the data foundations these projects rely on: AI-ready datasets, usage and observability data, evaluation data
  • Apply data architecture principles that make our data reliable, well-documented, and safely accessible for AI use cases (context, retrieval, access scoping)

Monitoring & Support:

  • Monitor pipelines and automations, troubleshoot incidents, and fix root causes
  • Document data models, pipelines, and processes for both technical and business readers

Collaboration & Learning:

  • Work with stakeholders - as diverse as Finance, People, Sales, and Product - to understand requirements and translate them into data solutions
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions
  • Continuously expand your knowledge of data engineering, automation, and AI best practices

What you'll do
  • Under the supervision of the Business Automation team’s more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.
    •  
    Automation Development:
  • Develop and maintain Python-based automations and solutions to streamline enterprise processes
  • Implement integrations between various systems and applications using APIs and other connection methods
  • Assist in maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automation projects
    •

  • Support the implementation of data pipelines that integrate data from various sources, including APIs, external databases, and third-party services
  • Assist in transforming raw data into clean and ready-to-use models using SQL and dbt
  • Collaborate on data quality monitoring and improvement initiatives
    •

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues with existing automation solutions
  • Assist in documentation of systems, processes, and workflows

  • Up to 3 years of relevant experience in data engineering, including apprenticeships, internships, and/or demonstrable personal projects

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

  • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

  • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

  • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

  • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

  • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

  • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

  • Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

    (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team

  • Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

  • Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

description:
About EHG

EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.

Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.

 

The opportunity

We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

 

What you'll own

  • One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland.

  • Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one.

  • In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment.

  • Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves.

  • Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria.

  • Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other.

  • Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities.

  • Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant.

  • Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly.

  • Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow.

 

What we're looking for

Core experience

  • Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance.

  • Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one.

  • Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability.

  • Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard.

  • Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects.

  • Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage.

  • The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure.

  • Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely.

Especially compelling

  • Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience.

  • Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes.

  • Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end.

  • Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators.

  • Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth.

  • Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you.

  • Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland.

  • The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth.

Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States.

title: Project Leider Bouw
description:
Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk.

We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural.

Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie.

Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf. Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken, of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet.

Over de functie

De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.

Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS.

Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit.

We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat.

De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team.

Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat.

Wat je gaat doen

  • De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project.

  • Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers.

  • Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge.

  • Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk.

  • Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren.

  • Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators.

Wat we zoeken

  • Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder.

  • Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie.

  • Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden.

  • Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen.

  • Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren.

  • Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen.

  • Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert.

  • Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager.

Waarom Monumental?

Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je.

Voor open sollicitaties (als je geen rol ziet die precies past) kun je ons mailen op:

Helaas bieden we op dit moment geen stageplekken aan.

Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen hierboven, maar ben je enthousiast over Monumental en denk je dat je ons toch kunt helpen moeilijke problemen op te lossen? Neem dan contact op. We verwelkomen generalisten die op resultaat gericht zijn en graag on the job leren.

title: Team Lead, Data Engineering
description:
We are looking for a Data Engineering Team Lead to lead the Data Platform team at DataSnipper.

Every decision DataSnipper makes about its products runs through the data platform: which features land, which customers are getting value, what we bill for, what we fix next, and which AI capabilities add the most value. You will lead a team of two data engineers who own the systems that make that possible. That means how usage events get captured across a growing set of products, how they become trustworthy models in Snowflake, and how Customer Success, Product and GTM get to answers without waiting on us.

This is a player-coach role in a small, high-ownership team. You are responsible for the people, the roadmap and the technical direction, and you stay hands-on enough to ship alongside the team and make architectural calls credibly. At DataSnipper, Team Lead is our entry point into engineering management: the same people, delivery and product responsibilities as an Engineering Manager, on a smaller team.

We are a handful of people serving the whole company, so your judgment about what not to build matters as much as what the team ships.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.

Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now OFFICIALLY the fastest-growing software company in the Netherlands according to Deloitte Fast50 and recently achieved Unicorn status in our latest funding round. With over 400.000 users in 125+ countries and a second base in the heart of New York City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there. At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential.

What your team owns

The Data Platform team works across three areas:

  • Data Platform: reliable, scalable infrastructure that gets the right data to the right place

  • Internal Analytics: a self-service platform so every team can be data-informed without a ticket

  • Customer-facing Analytics: the dashboards and exports customers use to see the value they get from DataSnipper

Concretely, you would be walking into billions of usage events flowing from our Excel Add-in, web apps and product backends through Azure Event Hubs into Snowflake; a dbt estate built on medallion principles and managed in dbt Cloud; Terraform-managed Snowflake and Azure infrastructure; and a set of product teams shipping AI agents faster than we can instrument them.

You will also find real, named open problems rather than a tidy platform: event capture mid-consolidation, multiple methods of user attribution, and a data quality layer that is designed but not yet built. We would rather tell you that up front.

What you will do

Lead the team

  • Lead a team of two data engineers through outcomes, not tasks: set clear goals with the team and trust them to figure out how

  • Make the team measurably better: raise the engineering bar, grow each engineer into bigger problems, and address performance issues directly when they arise

  • Run regular 1:1s, give clear and timely feedback, and own each engineer's goals and development

  • Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, documentation and operational excellence

  • Take part in hiring and help shape the team's scope as it evolves

Own direction and delivery

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and GTM to shape the team's roadmap, turning vague data requests into scoped, well-defined work

  • Make the trade-offs a small team serving the whole company needs: what to build, what to defer, and when a request shouldn't become a pipeline

  • Set the technical direction and make the architectural calls that shape the team's systems

  • Keep Snowflake performance and cost, tech debt, dependencies and compliance obligations (audit logging, vulnerability remediation, Vanta evidence) visible and under control

  • Be the person other engineering teams come to when they need to instrument something new

Stay hands-on in the data platform

  • Contribute to the event ingestion architecture end to end: Azure Event Hubs, Snowpipe, Fivetran, and our shared Python/TypeScript event client libraries

  • Build and review dbt transformation pipelines that stay reliable as volume, source count and model complexity grow

  • Define and enforce event contracts and schemas so product teams can instrument new features without silent breakage downstream

  • Evolve the core data models (event, user, license, company) and integrate new sources such as product backends, MongoDB, HubSpot and billing

  • Guide reverse ETL and activation work that pushes modeled data back into HubSpot, MongoDB, Postgres and GTM reporting

What you bring

Leadership

  • At least 1 year leading engineers as a team lead or engineering manager: 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, performance, and development

  • An empowerment style of leadership: you lead through outcomes and trust, not by assigning tasks

  • Early evidence of growing engineers and raising a team's bar, and the willingness to address performance issues directly

  • Strong product aptitude: you can challenge the framing of a request, translate stakeholder needs into technical solutions, and make roadmap trade-offs


Data engineering

  • 7+ years in data engineering or a closely related backend/platform role, with a track record of owning a data platform area end to end

  • Deep SQL and strong Python, including query optimization and performance tuning on a cloud warehouse

  • Production experience with a cloud data warehouse (we use Snowflake) and a modern transformation framework (we use dbt)

  • Experience with event-driven / streaming ingestion and its failure modes: schema drift, duplication, late data, backfills

  • Experience on a cloud platform at the infrastructure level (we're on Azure; AWS/GCP transfers fine)

  • Solid data modeling fundamentals and the ability to defend a modeling decision to both engineers and business stakeholders

  • Experience operating data systems in production with a focus on reliability, observability and maintainability


How you work

description:
Become a Part of ACCURIDS

Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data!

At ACCURIDS, we’re building the data backbone behind life-science innovation — a system that identifies, links, and standardizes critical enterprise data in compliance with global standards such as ISO IDMP.   • Own features end-to-end: Take full ownership of user-facing features across the stack, from refining business logic in modern Java/Spring Boot to building responsive React/TypeScript interfaces via GraphQL and REST APIs.
  • Amplify velocity with AI: Lead by example in our AI-native engineering culture. You will use tools like Cursor, Claude, or Gemini to accelerate scaffolding, refactoring, and test writing, while acting as the ultimate authority on architectural integrity, security, and quality. As agents take on more of the routine coding, your leverage moves up a level - you direct them, shape the architecture, and own the quality of what ships.
  • Shape next-gen architecture: Drive our evolution toward a multi-module Spring Modulith architecture, optimize complex PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch queries, and dive into domain-specific RDF semantic data structures.
  • Elevate quality & team standards: Raise the bar on engineering hygiene by maintaining rigorous test coverage (JUnit, Testcontainers, Playwright), conducting sharp merge request reviews (including AI-generated code), and mentoring junior engineers.

What helps you succeed:

  • Proven SaaS Experience: 5+ years of shipping and owning full-stack features in production software. A degree in Computer Science, Fachinformatiker training, or strong hands-on experience as a career-changer are all welcome.
  • AI-Native Mindset: AI tools (Cursor, Claude and Gemini) are an integral part of your daily workflow. You view AI as an output amplifier, combine high curiosity with deep technical judgment, and reject skepticism toward AI-assisted coding.
  • Location & Work Permit: You are based in Germany within a reasonable commuting distance to our Cologne office (NRW) and hold a valid German work permit.
  • Full-Stack Core Stack: Deep expertise in modern Java (17+), the Spring Boot ecosystem (Spring Security, Spring Data JPA), React 18, TypeScript, Redux, and GraphQL (Apollo Client).
  • Data & Testing Rigor: Strong hands-on experience with SQL/PostgreSQL, Flyway migrations, full-stack testing (Unit, Integration, E2E), and GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
  • Languages: Business fluent English is required; German skills are a strong plus.
  • Bonus Impact: Prior experience with semantic web tools (RDF, SPARQL, Apache Jena), Material UI (MUI 5), Elasticsearch, or pharma/life-sciences domains (FHIR, IDMP) is a major plus.

Why you’ll love working here:

  • Impactful Career Growth: Evolve into a Technical Lead / Lead Engineer role or deepen your specialization in semantic data platforms, AI features, or platform architecture as we scale.
  • Epic Office & Hybrid Work: Work from our brand-new office in the KölnTurm, featuring breathtaking views over the city (even higher than the view from the Cologne Cathedral!). Enjoy flexible hybrid options. (Note: On-site presence in Cologne/NRW is required; fully remote work is not offered).
  • Community & Industry Events: Connect and grow your network through exclusive industry events hosted regularly right in our scenic office space.
  • Competitive Compensation: Fixed salary package of €75,000 – €100,000 per year for a full-time, permanent position.
  • Work-Life Balance & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, a personal learning budget, hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux, Windows), and your choice between a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a €50/month City Plus Card.
  • Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies, and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product.

Not ticking every box?

Not ticking every box? We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn’t always follow a checklist and we care more about your potential, curiosity, and motivation to learn.

At ACCURIDS, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech, science, and data to apply.

title: (Senior) Accountant/ Buchhalter*in (all genders) in Berlin
description:
We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus.

Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum.

Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.

Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.

Your Role

Du arbeitest in unserem Finance-Team und verantwortest die korrekte und zuverlässige Buchung der Geschäftsvorfälle unserer Gesellschaften. Gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden Accounting-Team stellst du sicher, dass notwendige Zahlungen in allen Unternehmensbereichen korrekt abgewickelt und verbucht werden. Der Einsatz moderner Software-Lösungen beschleunigt und digitalisiert unsere Prozesse. Du nimmst eine zentrale Rolle im Unternehmen ein und stehst im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den verschiedenen Unternehmensbereichen.

Diese Position richtet sich an eine Person, die eigenverantwortlich arbeitet, Prozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und gemeinsam mit Homaris langfristig wachsen möchte.

What You'll Do

Geschäftsvorfälle prüfen und buchen. Du stellst sicher, dass sämtliche Geschäftsvorfälle in DATEV korrekt erfasst werden.

Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung verantworten. Du erfasst die Vorgänge ordnungsgemäß und betreust außerdem die Anlagen- und Bankbuchhaltung.

Zahlungseingänge und Zahlläufe steuern. Du kontrollierst die Zahlungseingänge und erstellst die erforderlichen Zahlläufe.

Steuermeldungen übermitteln. Du übermittelst die Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen und Übernachtungssteuererklärungen.

Konten abstimmen. Du führst Abstimmarbeiten im Sachkonten-, Debitoren- und Kreditorenbereich sowie für Intercompany-Konten durch.

Abschlüsse vorbereiten. Du übernimmst vorbereitende Tätigkeiten und arbeitest bei der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB mit.

Kreditkartenabrechnungen bearbeiten. Du bearbeitest und buchst die Kreditkartenabrechnungen über Pleo.

Prozesse digital weiterentwickeln. Du optimierst proaktiv Prozesse und erhöhst dabei den Digitalisierungsgrad.

What Makes You a Fit

Relevante Ausbildung und Erfahrung. Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung.

Kenntnisse im deutschen Rechnungswesen. Du verfügst über Kenntnisse des HGB und des Umsatzsteuergesetzes.

DATEV-Erfahrung. Du bringst Erfahrung mit der Buchhaltungssoftware DATEV mit.
Weiterbildung als Pluspunkt. Idealerweise hast du eine Weiterbildung zum/zur geprüften Bilanzbuchhalter:in (IHK) abgeschlossen.

Digitale Sicherheit. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel, und offen für eine digitale Arbeitsumgebung.

Eigenständigkeit und Teamgeist. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich, bist zugleich teamfähig und schaust gerne über den eigenen Aufgabenbereich hinaus.

Verbesserungsorientierung. Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und hast Interesse daran, deinen Bereich aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln.

Sprachkenntnisse. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B1-Niveau.

KI-Affinität. Du nutzt digitale Tools mit Leichtigkeit, erkennst ihr Potenzial und bist begeistert davon, wie KI den Arbeitsalltag effizienter gestalten kann.

Präsenz. Du arbeitest in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu kommen. Du arbeitest gerne persönlich mit anderen zusammen – denn genau so entsteht gute Arbeit.

The Environment

Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet.

Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.

What We Offer

Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst.

Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei.

Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor.

Next Steps

Wenn dich diese Position anspricht, freuen wir uns darauf, mehr über deine Erfahrungen und deine Perspektive zu erfahren.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf.

Wir nehmen uns Zeit, alle Bewerbungen sorgfältig zu prüfen, daher kann es 1-2 Wochen dauern, bis wir uns bei dir zurückmelden. Wir bitten dich um ein wenig Geduld und danken dir dafür!

Du hast Fragen? Melde dich gerne bei Naomi unter oder +49 1579 2465851

description:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”. Seit 1998 in Gründerhand, entwickeln wir Software und beraten Kunden aus allen Branchen. Wir setzen auf Cloud Native, modernisieren Software und unterstützen unsere Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten AI-Lösungen.

Wir bauen unseren Businessbereich “Generative AI” aus und suchen dafür dich, um gute Software für Kunden zu bauen, die relevante Probleme löst.

  • Du entwickelst Individualsoftware für verschiedene Kunden und unterschiedlichste Use-Cases auf Basis von LLMs (z. B. GPT, Claude, Mistral) unter Nutzung von Frameworks und Bibliotheken wie LangChain, LangGraph, Open Hermes, Transformers für Generative AI- und RAG-Pipelines.
  • Du nutzt und verarbeitet Daten über Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken, APIs, Cloud-Speicher und Legacy-/Unternehmenssysteme, damit AI-Anwendungen mit relevanten Informationen arbeiten, um für den Kunden echten Mehrwert zu schaffen.
  • Du bringst die Fähigkeit mit, dein bestehendes Know-How auf neue Herausforderungen anzuwenden.
  • Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der fachlichen und technischen Umsetzung von GenAI-Anwendungen und deren Integration.
  • Du teilst dein Wissen gerne, z. B. auf Konferenzen, Meetups oder in Fachartikeln.
  • Du nutzt Open Source zur Problemlösung und lässt Verbesserungen und Erweiterungen zurückfließen.
  • Du hast einen Blick auf den GenAI-Markt und die Weiterentwicklung von Technologien und Trends.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder IT-Beratung.
  • Erfahrung mit RAG- oder RAG-Pipelines unter Verwendung von Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken und LLMs.
  • Grundkenntnisse in probabilistischem Testen mit Testsets und Qualitätssicherung mit Metriken.
  • Du hast Spaß an der Interaktion mit Kunden (wie etwa bei der Beratung oder im Pre-Sales).
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch auf C1+ Niveau sowie konversationssicheres Englisch.
  • 1-2 Mal im Monat innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen, um Kunden und Kolleg:innen persönlich zu treffen, stellt kein Hindernis für dich dar.

Das haben wir zu bieten

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nachdem welche Erfahrungen und Kompetenzen du mitbringst, vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 65.000 € bis 75.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden.
  • Kein 08/15: Bei unseren AI-Projekten sind Forschungsgeist und Experimentierfreude gefragt, da wir innovative Konzepte verproben, um Lösungen mit hohem Kundennutzen zu schaffen.
  • Lass dich inspirieren: Arbeite mit einem der führenden Köpfe auf dem Gebiete der generative Artificial Intelligence - unserem CTO
  • Mache einen Unterschied: Du hast bei uns viel Verantwortung und einen großen Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir sind ein mittelständisches Unternehmen, in dem dein Beitrag unseren wirtschaftlichen Erfolg beeinflusst.
  • Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche stellen sicher, dass du dich stets weiterentwickelst.
  • Wir arbeiten selbtsorganisiert: Mit einem hohen Grad an Selbstorganisation und soziokratischen Strukturen hast du alle notwendigen Freiheitsgrade, um die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen. Wir schaffen den Rahmen, den du brauchst, um gut arbeiten zu können.
  • Werde berühmt: Du hast eine technische Redaktion, die dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren unterstützt, sodass du als Expert:in nach außen sichtbar wirst.
  • Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet, dass du nach Feierabend erreichbar bist, Nachrichten beantwortest trotz Krankmeldung oder im Urlaub noch ein paar Kleinigkeiten erledigst .
