title: Staff Frontend Engineer / Frontend Architect (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction

Teaser

Two products, two backends, one frontend vision: build the AI-first frontend platform and design system that lets our engineers, product managers and designers ship UI at speed. A senior hands-on role with architect-level influence, no people management, and our CPTO as your executive sponsor.

Role at a glance

  • Level: Staff/Principal-level individual contributor – technical leadership, no direct reports
  • Reporting line: VP Engineering. Executive sponsor: our CPTO
  • Products: FactFinder NG (React on a Java backend) and Infinity (React on a .NET/F# backend)
  • Stack you'll shape: React, TypeScript, Web Components, design tokens, Storybook, AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • Team: Product & Technology organization of around 25 people, led by our CPTO, working in a product trio model with product and design
  • Location: Berlin; Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm possible – hybrid with 2–3 office days per week; occasional travel (<10%) for offsites and design-system workshops
  • Start: as soon as possible

About FactFinder

FactFinder is one of the leading product discovery platforms for European eCommerce. For more than 20 years we've applied AI and machine learning to product search, navigation, personalization and recommendations. Our Product Discovery Experience (PDX) spans two products: FactFinder NG, an exact and highly configurable search, and Infinity, a self-learning, behavioral discovery engine. More than 2,000 customers generate over €160 billion in annual GMV on our platform.

We're around 90 people with a new management team, a clear growth plan and reknown investors behind us. Right now we're rebuilding our product and tech organization around an AI-first way of working and agentic commerce – and this role sits at the center of it.

Why this role exists

Our two products run two React frontends with very different technical roots. We need a vision, an architect, and an owner — someone who will unify them into a single, efficient system, build the shared design system on top, and enable product managers and designers to prototype and ship production-grade UI themselves with AI tooling. Incrementally, without a big-bang rewrite, and while both products keep shipping.


Your mission

What you'll do

  • Define and drive the target frontend architecture across both React products – one consistent, efficient React-based system, migrated step by step
  • Build and own our shared design system: tokens, component library and Web Components for embeddable shop UI, tightly aligned with Product Design
  • Create an AI-first prototyping and contribution framework – design system, AI coding tools, guardrails, automated review and CI – so product managers and designers can prototype and contribute production-grade UI
  • Stay hands-on: write a significant share of the critical code, set standards, and pair with and level up our frontend engineers
  • Work with a clear operating split: after architecture-focused first stints, spend around 80% of your time hands-on coding and 20% on architecture, design-system leadership and enablement
What success looks like
  • After 90 days: frontend audit of both products done, target architecture and migration roadmap agreed, design-system tokens and core components live, and the first prototype built and shipped by a product manager or designer on the new framework
  • After 12 months: both products run on the shared design system, the frontend rework shows measurable efficiency gains, and product and design prototype independently as a routine – frontend is no longer the bottleneck


Your profile

Must-have

  • Expert-level React and TypeScript, proven in complex production SaaS frontends
  • A real AI-first engineering practice: you use AI coding tools and agents daily and have built workflows or frameworks that others use – not just "I use Copilot"
  • Design-system architecture: you've built or led a design system (tokens, component library, Storybook or similar) that was adopted across multiple teams or products
  • Web Components (Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, embedding in third-party environments) plus a frontend architecture track record: you've modernized or migrated a frontend stack at least once, ideally several times
  • 6+ years in frontend or software engineering, including 3+ years at Staff, Lead or Architect level – setting technical direction across teams, not just within your own
  • Hands-on today: you write production code yourself – this is not a concept-only architect position
  • Business-fluent English (C1); no formal degree required, your track record counts
Nice-to-have
  • Technical leadership without line management: you've led a SaaS frontend team through a major technology change
  • Meta-frameworks such as Next.js and/or Astro – and a clear view on when to use which
  • Design-to-code and prototyping tooling: Figma workflows, design-token pipelines, AI UI generation (v0, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • eCommerce, search or product discovery frontends (search UIs, embeddable shop widgets)
  • React on non-JavaScript backends (Java/Spring, .NET); Fable/Feliz or Ant Design
  • Good German language skills


Bonus Points

Who thrives here

  • Builders who ship code themselves and lead by example
  • Pragmatic simplifiers: incremental migration over big-bang rewrites, no over-engineering
  • Change agents with strong opinions, weakly held – able to transform an organization without burning it out
  • Enablers who enjoy making product managers and designers productive and treat them as peers
Probably not for you if you'd rather produce architecture concepts than running code, want to go deep on one product and leave the cross-product system to others, or are looking for a people-management role.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

What we offer

  • Real ownership with executive backing: you shape the frontend of two products end to end. You report to our VP Engineering; our CPTO is the executive sponsor of this role – both agree the target architecture and migration roadmap with you, and the CPTO reviews your 90-day goals and holds your final interview. A company-level priority, not a side project
  • AI-first as a leadership priority, with the tooling budget to match: Claude Code, Cursor or whatever makes you fastest
  • Impact without switching to management: a Staff/Principal IC track on our career ladder toward Principal/Distinguished – with the option to move into engineering management later if you want to
  • A product trio culture: engineering, product and design as co-owners, outcomes over outputs
  • Competitive compensation that reflects the Staff level of this role
  • Training and conference budget, 30 days of vacation, modern equipment, mobility offers and a company pension plan
  • Hybrid work with 2–3 office days per week in Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm

How we hire

Remote, with feedback within 48 hours after every step:

1. 30-minute intro call with our Recruiter Mirko
2. 60-minute technical interview with our VP Engineering (your future manager) and an engineering lead: one frontend modernization you led, your design-system story, and how you use AI day to day
3. Case study: a hands-on part (AI tools explicitly welcome – walk us through how you used them) and a 45-minute architecture session
4. Team panel and a 45-minute conversation with our CPTO – optionally on site

FAQ

Is this a people-management role? No. It's a senior individual-contributor role: you lead through architecture, standards and enablement, without direct reports.

Who will I report to? Our VP Engineering. The role is sponsored by our CPTO: the frontend platform is one of the CPTO's top priorities, you agree the target architecture and migration roadmap together, and the CPTO holds your final interview.

Which tech stack will I work with? React and TypeScript on both products. FactFinder NG runs on a Java backend, Infinity on .NET/F# (with Fable/Feliz on the frontend). Backend, F# and our search domain are things you can learn here – React expertise, Web Components, design-system architecture and AI-first practice are what you bring from day one.

Is "AI-first" real here, or a buzzword? It's driven by our CPTO and part of the career ladder for every engineer. Your mandate is to take it from individual productivity to organization-wide practice.

Two legacy frontends on Java and .NET – isn't that painful? That's exactly the mandate: unify them, and how is your call. Incremental, not big-bang.

Can I work fully remote? No – the role is hybrid with 2–3 office days per week at one of our offices.

Why eCommerce search? Because agentic commerce is where AI meets real purchase decisions – on our platform that's 2,000+ shops and €160+ billion in GMV a year.

Apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile plus links to work you're proud of (GitHub, a design system, a talk, a blog post) – and tell us in three sentences how you use AI in your daily engineering work. No cover letter needed.

Your contact: Mirko Duus

title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
description:
What we do

At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
We help companies get compensation right.

What we get paid at work has a massive impact on our lives, and it’s one of the biggest factors in hiring and retaining talent - and yet so many companies struggle to get it right. They simply have no choice but to rely on poor data and unsophisticated tools for their pay decisions. That’s why we created Ravio.

We help many of the world’s most innovative and ambitious companies build stronger teams and reach their goals through better compensation. Our real-time data platform brings compensation into the modern age, tracking the market across all compensation types from salary to equity and benefits. We’re passionate about ensuring everyone is paid what they deserve, no matter their background or circumstances. We believe that when compensation is done right, everyone wins.

Ravio is growing fast, which means you can too. We’ve established ourselves as the European leader in our space serving more than 1,200 clients, and now have our sights set on becoming the global go to place for compensation data and tools for managing compensation.

Joining a startup and scaling it into a global product is one of the most challenging and rewarding experiences a career can offer. If that sounds exciting to you, you’re in the right place.

The role

We’re looking for a Lead Data Engineer to lead a small team of data engineers within our Engineering team. You’ll remain hands-on in designing, building, and operating the data systems behind our compensation benchmarks, customer-facing tools, and AI agents. You’ll take a platform engineering approach to data, building reliable, reusable capabilities that help Engineering, Data Science, and Insights deliver. You’ll combine technical leadership with line management and coaching, working with engineering and product colleagues to turn priorities into delivered outcomes.

You’ll report to our VP Engineering.

Hands-on engineering and delivery

  • Be a senior technical contributor, building and operating the pipelines, integrations, and data services behind Ravio’s product. Design clear interfaces between ingestion, transformation, and downstream applications so teams can build on trusted data without bespoke support for every change.

  • Shape and deliver the data roadmap with Product, Data Science, and Insights. Prioritise improvements that deliver customer value, reduce recurring manual work, or address reliability needs, while keeping complexity and cloud costs under control.

  • Build data quality, governance, and security into everyday delivery through automated checks, clear data ownership, and appropriate access controls.

  • Work with engineering colleagues to integrate data systems into shared development, deployment, and monitoring practices. Use version-controlled transformations, automated tests, and repeatable deployments, reducing bespoke tooling where it adds unnecessary overhead.

  • Own the reliability and day-to-day support of the team’s production data systems, improving monitoring and recovery. Build reusable ingestion patterns and self-service workflows around recurring needs, measuring their value through faster delivery, fewer failures, and less manual support.

  • Use AI-assisted tools for development, testing, documentation, and investigation. Help the team use them effectively, with appropriate review of outputs and protection of customer data.

Team management and leadership

  • Lead the team’s delivery planning and ways of working, keeping priorities, scope, and dependencies visible. Take part in shared product prioritisation, bringing requests from Data Science, Insights, and Operations into an agreed delivery plan.

  • Partner with software engineers, product managers, and data colleagues to make timely decisions and share responsibility for delivered outcomes.

  • Line manage and coach a small team of data engineers, providing regular feedback and supporting their technical and career development.

  • Build a supportive, accountable team with shared ownership of its systems. Use pairing, code reviews, documentation, and operational handovers to spread knowledge.

What we’re looking for

  • Six-plus years’ experience in data engineering, with at least two years in a team leadership role.

  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building and operating production data systems.

  • Experience with data modelling, transformation frameworks such as dbt, and workflow orchestration.

  • Experience applying platform engineering principles to data systems, such as reusable ingestion patterns, clear data interfaces, or self-service tooling that other teams use successfully.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD).

  • Practical understanding of reliable data processing, including schema changes, retries, safe reprocessing, and backfills.

  • Experience using monitoring and data quality checks to investigate failures and improve reliability.

  • Practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools, with sound judgement about verification, security, and where automation adds value.

  • Proven ability to mentor engineers, set team goals, and deliver value for users and the business.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with a bias for action.

  • Excellent listening and communication skills.

How you work

  • You speak the language of engineers and data scientists, and are comfortable working with Product, Customer Success, Operations, and founders.

  • You bring empathy and strong social and emotional intelligence, with an ability to put yourself in others’ shoes.

  • You take satisfaction in solving challenging problems and helping a talented team deliver effectively.

Our tech stack

Data Engineering

  • Python and SQL

  • dbt for data transformations

  • dlt for data extraction and loading

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Cloud Functions, Workflows, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Datastream

  • PostgreSQL

Data Science

  • Python (polars, pandas, scikit)

  • Jupyter notebooks

Infrastructure and delivery

Data engineering at Ravio

Data is central to Ravio’s product. As we expand our compensation tools and build AI-powered experiences, we need reliable ways to bring customer data in and make it available across the platform.

You’ll help a small team deliver that work alongside software engineers, data scientists, and product colleagues. Success means useful capabilities reaching customers, dependable data for colleagues, and less time spent on avoidable support and manual processes.

title: Fraud Analyst
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We are looking for a Fraud Analyst to join Pleo’s Decision Intelligence team and help strengthen how we detect, prevent, monitor, and respond to fraud risk across our financial crime decisioning setup.

This is not a traditional Fraud Operations case-handling role. You will work closer to the decisioning layer: helping translate fraud patterns into rules, monitoring rule performance, supporting rule testing, reviewing alert behaviour, and making sure fraud controls remain effective, explainable, and proportionate.

You will join at an important stage as Pleo continues to mature its fraud and AML decisioning capability. The right person will help improve speed, resilience, and quality in how we create, test, deploy, monitor, and tune fraud rules.

What you’ll be doing

You will help operate and improve Pleo’s fraud decisioning capability, with a focus on card fraud and related financial crime risk scenarios.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the end-to-end fraud rule lifecycle: from rule proposal and analysis through testing, deployment, monitoring, tuning, and rollback.

  • Working directly in, or closely with, decisioning tools and rule engines to support fraud detection logic.

  • Analysing fraud patterns, alert trends, false positives, false negatives, and rule performance.

  • Translating FraudOps insights and stakeholder requests into clear, structured rule proposals.

  • Helping assess whether new rules or threshold changes are justified by data.

  • Monitoring post-deployment rule performance and identifying when rules need adjustment.

  • Supporting daily operational requests related to fraud controls, while ensuring changes are traceable and well documented.

  • Partnering with FraudOps, AML, Product, Engineering, Data, Compliance, and Legal to make sure decisioning changes are aligned and risk-aware.

  • Maintaining clear documentation for fraud rules, rationale, expected impact, testing outcomes, and monitoring results.

  • Helping reduce single points of failure by building repeatable processes and stronger business continuity around fraud decisioning.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for someone who combines fraud domain knowledge with practical experience working in a decisioning environment.

You should have:

  • Experience as a Fraud Analyst, Risk Analyst, Fraud Strategy Analyst, Fraud Rules Analyst, Decisioning Analyst, or similar.

  • Hands-on experience with a decisioning tool, fraud rules engine, risk platform, or internal decisioning system.

  • Experience creating, testing, monitoring, or tuning fraud rules, thresholds, scenarios, or risk logic.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data to assess rule performance and fraud patterns.

  • Good understanding of fraud typologies, especially card fraud, transaction fraud, account misuse, or payment fraud.

  • Ability to balance fraud prevention with customer impact and operational workload.

  • Experience working with false positives and understanding that good fraud controls require continuous monitoring and tuning.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain rule logic, rationale, risks, and expected outcomes clearly.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with FraudOps, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Data teams.

  • A structured mindset and appreciation for documentation, traceability, governance, and change control.

  • Fintech, banking, payments, spend management, or regulated financial services.

  • SQL or basic data analysis.

What success looks like

In your first 3 months, success would look like:

  • You understand Pleo’s fraud decisioning setup and can confidently support day-to-day rule operations.

  • Fraud rule requests are better structured, documented, and traceable.

  • Rule changes are supported by data, clear rationale, and expected impact.

  • Post-deployment monitoring is more consistent and visible.

  • FraudOps and DI have a stronger operating rhythm for proposing, reviewing, deploying, and tuning fraud controls.

Why join us?

This is a rare opportunity to help shape a growing decisioning function from the inside. You will not just be reviewing fraud alerts, you will help define how fraud detection logic is built, governed, monitored, and improved.

You will join a team that is building the foundations for more scalable, data-driven, and resilient financial crime decisioning. If you enjoy working at the intersection of fraud strategy, operations, data, systems, and product, this role will give you real ownership and impact.

Apply if this sounds like you

You are analytical, structured, curious, and comfortable challenging assumptions. You know that fraud rules are never “set and forget.” You understand the importance of balancing risk reduction, customer experience, operational workload, and governance.

Most importantly, you have worked with decisioning tools or rule-based risk systems before and want to help build a stronger fraud decisioning capability at scale.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

title: Privacy & Product Counsel
description:
Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies.

We're looking for a Privacy & Product Counsel who can build Hilbert's privacy program from the inside of the product - not bolt one on after the fact - who is fluent across US, UK, and European privacy law, and who can move at the speed our engineering and GTM teams already move at, with the ownership and urgency of a startup culture.

You'll be the first dedicated privacy hire, embedded with product and engineering as we design agentic systems that touch consumer data across dozens of enterprise environments and the person our biggest customers' legal and security teams call when they want to understand how our AI actually handles their data - wherever they're based. Introduction to Role & Team

Bumble Inc. is looking for an Operations Specialist, AI Enablement to join our CX & Trust team. Trust, care, and high-quality experiences are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by improving how our AI-powered customer experience and moderation systems support our community.

You’ll evaluate AI-powered customer interactions and automated moderation decisions against Bumble’s policies, processes, and quality standards, helping us understand where our systems are performing well and where they can improve. Through quality reviews, accurate case labelling, golden-set maintenance, and thoughtful analysis, you’ll help ensure AI-supported decisions are consistent, precise, and grounded in the nuance required to serve our members responsibly. You’ll work closely with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager and colleagues across CX & Trust, taking ownership of high-quality work and demonstrating our Bumble values of Courage, Curiosity, Respect, and Excellence as we reimagine how AI can strengthen trust and care across the member experience.

This role will be based in London and will work in a hybrid model.

What you’ll do

  • Conduct quality reviews of AI-powered customer conversations and automated moderation decisions, assessing their alignment with Bumble’s community policies, operational processes, and quality standards.

  • Analyse policy enforcement gaps and nuanced cases, identifying where automated decisions may be inconsistent, unclear, or misaligned with policy intent and surfacing actionable insights for improvement.

  • Perform accurate case labelling to support AI model training, evaluation pipelines, and ongoing quality benchmarking, demonstrating Excellence through careful and consistent application of established guidance.

  • Review and maintain golden sets that reflect current policy standards and provide reliable ground truth for assessing AI quality, accuracy, and precision.

  • Report quality issues through established workflows, taking ownership of accurate categorisation, clear documentation, and actionable feedback, and seeing insights through to meaningful impact.

  • Collaborate purposefully with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager on scoring consistency, calibration, recurring quality issues, and opportunities to strengthen AI reliability and the member experience.

  • Identify patterns and share learnings that can improve AI accuracy and precision, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency, approaching emerging challenges with Curiosity and an agile mindset.

  • Use QA platforms and AI-supported tools, including systems such as Cinder, Zendesk QA, and Bumble’s internal assessment tooling, to monitor quality and understand AI behaviour, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before acting on results.

  • Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • Bring experience or transferable skills from Trust & Safety, content moderation, Customer Experience, quality assurance, or another fast-paced, policy-driven environment.

  • Have a sharp eye for detail and can objectively evaluate conversations, moderation decisions, and other interactions against established policies, processes, and quality standards.

  • Bring familiarity with conversational AI systems, chatbots, automated moderation, or AI-supported workflows, with the Curiosity to continue learning how these systems behave, where their limitations lie, and how human judgment can improve their effectiveness.

  • Understand, or are motivated to learn, quality assurance practices such as case labelling, calibration, consistent scoring, golden-set evaluation, and clear documentation of quality findings.

  • Are comfortable learning digital tools and platforms and can use data and quality insights to identify meaningful patterns while adapting your approach as systems, policies, and priorities evolve.

  • Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your deliverables, and see work through from insight to impact while welcoming feedback as an opportunity to learn and improve.

  • Apply AI thoughtfully and responsibly, assessing outputs for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness rather than relying on them without review, and demonstrate Bumble’s values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and colleagues.

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.


Your Mission

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver.
You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.
You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.
Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.

Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome


What you'll own

  • Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver.
  • Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact.
  • Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am.
  • Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access.
  • Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable.
  • Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure.
  • Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job.


What success looks like

  • You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use.
  • Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why.
  • You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it.
  • You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you.
  • You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.


What it takes

  • You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast.
  • You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows.
  • You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy.
  • You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration.
  • You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem.
  • You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers.
  • You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them.
Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC.

  • LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows.

  • Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning.

  • Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it.

  • Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard.


Why Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit.

  • Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.

  • Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.

  • Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week.

Darauf arbeiten wir gemeinsam hin: die erste große Marke für Altenpflege in Europa. Die gibt es bisher nicht.

Wenn du es leid bist, deine beste Idee in einer Präsentation sterben zu sehen, ist das hier der Unterschied: keine Pitch-Runden, keine Freigabekette, keine dritte Feedbackschleife. Du stellst deine Idee dem Performance-Marketing und den Gründern vor, und ihr entscheidet im selben Gespräch. Was montags beschlossen wird, läuft spätestens in der Woche darauf.

Wir sind eine der größten Plattformen im deutschen 24-Stunden-Pflegemarkt, finanziert von führenden Investoren wie Capnamic, Almaz Capital, RTL Ventures und Swiss Health Ventures, mit einem bundesweiten Franchise-System und Teams in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig.

Level: Senior. Du planst und koordinierst: Kanäle, Budget, Timing, Briefings. Die Texte schreibst du selbst.

An deiner Seite: unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager. Dort liegen Analyse, Attribution und die Aussteuerung der bezahlten Kanäle. Bei dir liegen Marke, Kampagnen und die Kanäle daneben. Ihr arbeitet auf Augenhöhe an einem Funnel.

Founder-Nähe: du arbeitest eng und direkt mit den Gründern an Marke, Botschaft und Ideen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.

Deine Rolle in unserem Team

Du bist die erste Person bei marta, die ausschließlich für die Marke da ist. 8 von 10 unserer treuesten Familien würden marta weiterempfehlen. Diese Geschichte erzählt bisher niemand systematisch.   • Produktion briefen. Für Film, Design und größere Produktionen arbeitest du mit Freelancern und Spezialisten. Du briefst sie, beurteilst, was zurückkommt, und hältst die Marke über alle Kanäle konsistent.
  • Social Media, UGC und Community. Hinter marta steht eine große Community aus Betreuungskräften. Daraus machst du Formate, Geschichten und nutzergenerierte Inhalte. Unser Ziel: der größte Pflegekanal Deutschlands. 
  • PR und Presse. Du arbeitest mit einer PR-Agentur, schreibst Pressemitteilungen und baust Regionalpresse als Kanal auf.
  • CRM und Lifecycle. Die Entscheidung für eine 24-Stunden-Betreuung zieht sich über Wochen. Willkommensstrecken, Reaktivierung, WhatsApp: die richtige Botschaft zum richtigen Zeitpunkt statt nur Bottom of Funnel. Die Strecken füllst du mit dem richtigen Content und hast ein Auge dafür was funktioniert und was nicht.
  • Botschaft und Tonalität. Du übersetzt unsere fünf Personas in konkrete Botschaften und Touchpoints. Familien entscheiden emotional und nach Qualität, nicht nach Preis. Dein Text muss das treffen.

Intro

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder, weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Lasst uns sie von Anfang an richtig bauen.

Tasks

Customer Experience ist bei uns kein Support-Ticket-Job. Du besitzt den kompletten Kundenlebenszyklus nach dem Vertragsabschluss — kommerziell, operativ und im Produkt.

Damit sitzt du an der Stelle im Unternehmen, an der beide Seiten gleichzeitig sichtbar sind: Du weißt, was Kunden wirklich brauchen und wofür sie zahlen — und du weißt, was das Produkt kann und was es kosten würde, es zu können. Genau daraus entstehen die besten Produktentscheidungen und die besten Deals.

Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und baust den Bereich so, wie er in zwei Jahren für dreißig Leute funktionieren muss.

💰 Revenue Ownership

  • Du besitzt einen Kundenstamm mit klarer Umsatzverantwortung: Retention, Expansion, Renewals.

  • Du erkennst, wo ein Kunde mehr Wert ziehen könnte, und machst den Upsell selbst – weitere Nutzer, weitere Projekte, weitere Produkte.

  • Du verhandelst Verlängerungen und Erweiterungen und führst sie bis zur Unterschrift.

🚀 Value Creation über den gesamten Kundenlebenszyklus

  • Du übernimmst den Kunden ab dem ersten Onboarding-Kontakt: Setup, Projektdaten, Konfiguration, Schulung der Teams.

  • Du führst den Rollout vom Pilotprojekt in die Fläche – und sorgst dafür, dass die Nutzung nicht nach vier Wochen einschläft.

  • Du machst Value Reviews mit messbaren Zahlen statt Höflichkeitsterminen und machst sichtbar, was alago dem Kunden konkret gebracht hat.

🛟 Customer Support

  • Du verantwortest unseren Support: Anfragen beantworten, priorisieren, Muster erkennen.

  • Du debuggst Customer Flows in der Software selbst – du reichst ein Problem nicht weiter, du reproduzierst es, grenzt es ein und beschreibst es so, dass es lösbar ist.

  • Du baust Doku, Self-Service und KI-gestützte Antworten so auf, dass dieselbe Frage nicht zehnmal auf deinem Tisch landet.

⚙️ Product Engine – du baust mit

  • Du löst selbst, was sich ohne Engineering lösen lässt: Konfiguration, Datenbereinigung, kleine Automatisierungen und Skripte – mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder n8n. Was Code im Kernprodukt braucht, übergibst du so präzise an unser Engineering-Team, dass es schnell gelöst ist.

  • Du verantwortest Integrationen und Datenimporte: Du scopst die Anbindung an Kundensysteme, prüfst, was machbar ist, und bringst Migrationen gemeinsam mit unserem Engineering-Team ins Ziel – damit ein Onboarding Stunden statt Tage dauert.

  • Du übersetzt, was Nutzer, Projektleitungen, IT und QM wirklich brauchen, in klare, priorisierte Produkt-Inputs – mit Belegen, nicht mit Bauchgefühl. Was du selbst lösen kannst, löst du selbst.

  • Du testest neue Releases aus Kundensicht, bevor sie live gehen, und bist die Stimme des Kunden im Produktprozess.

🏗️ Den Bereich aufbauen

  • Du schreibst die Playbooks für Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell – und automatisierst sie, wo immer es geht.

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI-Agents und Automatisierungen, die Customer Experience bei uns skalierbar machen, statt den Bereich mit Köpfen zu vergrößern.

Requirements

Muss-Kriterien

  • Du hattest bereits direkten Kundenkontakt in einer verantwortlichen Rolle – du hast Kunden selbst geführt, nicht nur zugearbeitet

  • Du hast Umsatzverantwortung getragen oder Umsatz ausgebaut (Renewals, Upsells, Expansion, Abschlüsse) und kannst das mit Zahlen belegen

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch

  • Standort München oder Bereitschaft, dauerhaft von hier aus zu arbeiten

Wie du arbeitest

  • AI-native: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Claude Code, Lovable o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine fundierte Meinung dazu, was taugt.

  • Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht den einzelnen Kunden, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu lösen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht – und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn die nächste Person versteht.

  • Technische Tiefe: Du gehst ins Produkt hinein: Daten prüfen, Flows nachvollziehen, Logs lesen, ein Problem sauber eingrenzen – und wo es geht, mit KI-Tools selbst beheben, sonst so beschreiben, dass es lösbar ist. Du fühlst dich in einer Software wohl, nicht nur in einer Präsentation darüber.

  • Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Was du übernimmst, landet nicht im Nirgendwo.

  • Kommerzieller Instinkt: Du erkennst den Moment, in dem aus einem zufriedenen Kunden ein größerer Kunde wird – und sprichst ihn an, statt zu warten.

Persönlicher Hintergrund

  • DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus

  • Persönliche Eigenschaften: Du bist leidenschaftlich, neugierig, wettbewerbsorientiert und lernbereit / gut coachbar

  • Idealerweise bist du über eine persönliche Empfehlung aus unserem AAA-Netzwerk (Founders, Team, Partner, VCs etc.) auf uns aufmerksam geworden

Pluspunkte

  • Du hast selbst schon aktiv entwickelt – eigene Projekte, Skripte, Integrationen, ein Side Project, das tatsächlich läuft

  • Du hast schon mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren Coding-Agents) echte Sachen gebaut und weißt, wie weit man damit ohne Engineering-Team kommt

  • Du kennst Teile unseres Stacks (TypeScript, React, Supabase) schon aus eigenen Projekten

  • Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr

  • Du hast bereits in einem schnell wachsenden Early-Stage-Startup gearbeitet und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn es noch kein Playbook gibt

  • Du hast schon einmal einen Bereich oder Prozess von null aufgebaut

Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve.

Warum alago?

Du bist die erste Person für Customer Experience bei alago. Es gibt keinen bestehenden Bereich, in den du dich einfügst – du entscheidest, wie er aussieht: welche Prozesse, welche Tools, welche Standards, welche Kennzahlen. Was du baust, bleibt.

Du wirst einer der tragenden Pfeiler dieser Firma

alago wird von sechs, sieben Bereichen getragen. Customer Experience ist einer davon – und du besitzt ihn. Du sitzt bei den Entscheidungen am Tisch, die die Firma prägen, nicht nur bei denen über deine Kunden. Der Weg von hier führt zum Head of Customer Experience mit eigenem Team.

Du entwickelst dich in eines der gefragtesten Profile überhaupt

  • One quality measurement standard and defect taxonomy in place across AI and human channels, replacing two divergent stacks.

  • QA coverage of support and clinical interactions increasing via automation, with calibration variance and inter-rater agreement inside range.

  • Reliable critical-error (compliance/HIPAA) catch rates.

  • Leadership and cross-functional partners have a trusted, evidence-based read on where quality is breaking and why, across AI and human-delivered service alike.

  • Forming and maintaining strong, trusted relationships with customers, proactively managing expectations and carefully controlling project scope

  • Leading effective project meetings and ensuring clear, consistent communication of purpose and direction to both internal teams and clients

  • Identifying risks early, and leading teams to implement effective mitigating actions to ensure project success

  • Developing compelling proposals and sales pitches to generate new leads and identify opportunities for additional account growth

  • Mentoring and developing project team members’ skills, aligning their responsibilities with their professional growth

  • Advising clients on AI strategy and solutions, while articulating the value of AI in diverse business contexts

 
 

Who we're looking for:

  • You’ve demonstrable success delivering complex technology projects from software engineering to AI products, preferably within the setting of consulting technology, or data-driven organisations.

  • You are adept at building and maintaining customer trust and translating between technical detail and core business challenges

  • You possess strong professional experience in the education sector. You have a high level of understanding of education policy and education technology, in the UK and internationally, with particular areas of specialism. You have an existing network within the education sector

  • You can provide a structured, analytical, and technical breakdown of problems, defining solutions that enhance customer workflows

  • You have demonstrated experience in the smooth delivery of excellent outcomes, using methodologies like Agile, Scrum, or Kanban

  • You are comfortable working in an ambiguous setting and have a clear understanding of how to structure commercials and pricing

  • You can identify and implement new business opportunities, including finding growth within accounts and visible support on external business development

 

The Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (60 minutes)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Culture and Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

 

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

  • RF/Microwave Design: Solve complex challenges related to insertion loss, impedance matching, and cross-talk at the PCB and package levels.

  • Core EE Fundamentals: Solid understanding of developing schematics, electro-mechanical interfaces, RF layout trades, temperature dependent behavior, shielding, signal integrity, and impedance analysis.

  • Packaging & Interconnects: Background in high-density interconnects, high frequency flex interconnects, 3D packaging, or advanced integration.

title: Project & Account Manager B2B
description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

We groeien hard. En naast individuele woningeigenaren werken we ook steeds meer samen met woningcorporaties, vastgoedeigenaren en vastgoedbeheerders die grotere aantallen woningen willen verduurzamen.

Daarom zoeken we een B2B Account & Project Manager die deze projecten van begin tot eind in goede banen leidt. Iemand die overzicht houdt, afspraken nakomt en ervoor zorgt dat klanten, bewoners, installateurs en interne teams weten waar ze aan toe zijn.

Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen onze zakelijke klanten en de mensen die de projecten uitvoeren. Je zorgt dat plannen niet alleen op papier kloppen, maar ook in de praktijk werken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol realiseren van grotere warmtepompprojecten. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de installatie van warmtepompen in 50 woningen binnen één wijk, waarbij meerdere installatieteams, bewoners en externe partners betrokken zijn.

Je zorgt dat projecten soepel verlopen

  • Je vertaalt afspraken met zakelijke klanten naar een concreet projectplan met duidelijke deadlines, verantwoordelijkheden en deliverables.

  • Je bewaakt de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit en afgesproken KPI's van projecten.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met onze Installation Quality Specialist aan de voorbereiding en uitvoering van projecten. Jij houdt de regie over het totale project, terwijl de Installation Quality Specialist de technische kwaliteit bewaakt.

  • Je stemt de voorbereiding en uitvoering af met onze interne teams, installateurs en externe partners.

  • Je signaleert risico's en knelpunten vroegtijdig en zorgt dat ze worden opgelost voordat ze de voortgang in gevaar brengen.

  • Je houdt overzicht over meerdere projecten tegelijk en stelt prioriteiten waar nodig.

Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor onze zakelijke klanten

  • Je onderhoudt relaties met woningcorporaties, vastgoedeigenaren en vastgoedbeheerders.

  • Je zorgt dat klanten weten wat ze kunnen verwachten, hoe projecten ervoor staan en welke beslissingen nodig zijn.

  • Je organiseert de afstemming tussen alle betrokken partijen, van de opdrachtgever tot de bewoners en installatieteams.

  • Je rapporteert over de voortgang, resultaten en kwaliteit van projecten en bespreekt verbeterpunten met klanten.

  • Je bouwt aan langdurige klantrelaties door afspraken waar te maken en problemen goed op te lossen.

Je helpt ons steeds slimmer te werken

  • Je kijkt kritisch naar hoe we grotere installatieprojecten organiseren en uitvoeren.

  • Je gebruikt projectdata en KPI's om te begrijpen wat goed gaat en waar we kunnen verbeteren.

  • Je helpt processen te ontwikkelen waarmee we steeds grotere aantallen woningen efficiënt en met hoge kwaliteit kunnen verduurzamen.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die structuur kan aanbrengen in complexe projecten, maar ook pragmatisch is wanneer de werkelijkheid anders loopt dan gepland. Je kunt schakelen tussen een gesprek met een vastgoedmanager en het oplossen van een praktisch probleem met een installatieteam.

Dit vinden we belangrijk:

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met projectmanagement, waarbij je zelf verantwoordelijk was voor planning, voortgang, kwaliteit en resultaten.

  • Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen, zowel intern als extern.

  • Je weet hoe je meerdere projecten, deadlines en belangen tegelijkertijd managet zonder het overzicht te verliezen.

  • Je bent gewend om met KPI's te werken en hierover helder te rapporteren.

  • Je neemt eigenaarschap. Als iets niet volgens plan loopt, wacht je niet af maar kom je met een oplossing.

  • Je bent organisatorisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en werkt graag in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en kunt je goed redden in het Engels.

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste:

  • Ervaring met woningcorporaties, vastgoedbeheerders of andere zakelijke partijen in de vastgoedsector.

  • Ervaring met de uitrol van grotere verduurzamings-, installatie- of renovatieprojecten.

Bij DeWarmte krijg je de kans om direct bij te dragen aan de energietransitie. Je werkt niet aan abstracte plannen, maar aan projecten die ervoor zorgen dat steeds meer woningen daadwerkelijk van het gas af kunnen.

description:
Become part of our mission

With high-end software engineering, we inspire our customers every day through digital transformation projects. What makes the decisive difference in our success? Our XITASOnians - the people who go above and beyond every day. As part of our agile talent development, we ensure that every individual at XITASO can reach their full potential right from the start.

During your  working student position, you’ll have the opportunity to help shape agile talent development up close - from supporting our mentoring system to employee satisfaction and exciting future topics such as the use of AI in talent development. We look forward to seeing the impact you’ll make through a variety of operational and conceptual tasks!

We’re interested in a long-term collaboration and are flexible in structuring the working student position. The expected number of hours is 20 hours per week.


These tasks interest you

  • You’ll provide support across various areas of talent development, such as the design of new development formats or the further enhancement of our agile feedback structures.
  • You’ll contribute to the continuous optimization of our internal mentoring system and play an active role in the co-creation of various mentoring formats and tools.
  • You’ll take responsibility for the area of employee satisfaction as your own project - from preparation and regular execution to deriving concrete actions from our employee satisfaction survey, as well as ensuring its continuous improvement and valid foundation.
  • You’ll assist with operational tasks in talent development, such as organizational tasks in preparing training events or maintaining data.
  • Together with us, you’ll explore how AI can facilitate and enrich our agile talent development.
  • You’ll take on research tasks and in-depth analyses, such as cross-comparisons of mentoring concepts in other agile organizations, human empowerment in dealing with complexity and ambiguity, and motivation and empowerment outside of hierarchical structures.


That makes you stand out

  • You are studying (Business) Psychology or HR Management or are pursuing a comparable degree program - in the second half of your bachelor’s program or in your master’s program.
  • You have already gained some professional experience in the field of HR, ideally in Talent Development.
  • You enjoy familiarizing yourself with new, complex topics, such as agile talent development or lateral leadership. 
  • You’re excited to learn new tools and have an affinity for and openness to working with AI. 
  • You’re an excellent team player and stand out for your enthusiasm, proactivity, and ability to work independently.
  • You are open to serving as a workshop facilitator on a long-term basis or speaking internally on talent development topics.
  • You possess very strong communication skills and can perform your role in German and English (at least C1 level in each language).

New Work & Culture

  • Responsibility and the opportunity to shape the work
  • An open culture of learning from mistakes and giving feedback
Mentoring & Personal Development
  • Individual mentoring from day one
  • Regular development reviews (catch-ups)
  • Leadership on a equal footing, based on trust and respect

  • Technical and cross-functional training
  • Internal TechTalks, external training courses, and conferences

  • Challenging, innovative, and diverse projects

  • Subsidy for childcare costs of up to 250 € per child

In dieser Rolle entwickelst du interne Tools, Services und Schnittstellen, übersetzt Anforderungen aus den Fachbereichen in pragmatische technische Lösungen und verbindest bestehende Systeme sinnvoll miteinander. title: AI Trainers Network - Arabic
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Trainers Network – Arabic based in Germany.

Join a global network of language professionals and culturally aware contributors helping shape the future of artificial intelligence.
In this flexible, remote opportunity, you can contribute to projects that improve the accuracy, relevance, and inclusivity of AI systems.
Depending on your skills and availability, you may work on text, image, or audio annotation, content evaluation, and prompt creation.
Your Arabic language expertise and cultural understanding will help make AI-generated content more natural, reliable, and representative of diverse communities.
Projects vary in scope and duration, offering opportunities to gain experience with emerging AI technologies while working on your own terms.
This is a talent network opportunity rather than an active job opening, meaning you will be contacted when a suitable project becomes available.
Before each project begins, you will receive clear information about the tasks, timeline, and compensation so you can decide whether it fits your interests and availability.


Accountabilities

As a contributor to the AI Trainers Network, you will support projects designed to improve AI performance, language understanding, and content quality. Depending on the project requirements and your areas of expertise, your responsibilities may include:

  • Annotating and labeling text, images, or audio to help train and improve AI models.

  • Evaluating search results, advertisements, and chatbot responses for accuracy, relevance, quality, and usefulness.

  • Creating, testing, and refining prompts to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs).

  • Reviewing AI-generated content to ensure linguistic accuracy, natural Arabic expression, and cultural appropriateness.

  • Identifying errors, inconsistencies, and potentially misleading or unsuitable content in AI outputs.

  • Applying project-specific guidelines and quality standards while maintaining consistency and attention to detail.

  • Contributing feedback that helps develop safer, more inclusive, and human-centered AI systems.

  • Managing assigned tasks independently and meeting project deadlines according to agreed requirements and availability.

    • Requirements

    We are looking for detail-oriented, curious, and adaptable contributors who are interested in language, technology, and the development of AI systems. The ideal candidate combines strong Arabic language skills with the ability to evaluate information critically and work independently in a digital environment.

    • Native or near-native fluency in Arabic, with a strong understanding of grammar, vocabulary, and linguistic nuances.

    • Current residence in Poland for this opportunity.

    • Good English proficiency to understand project instructions and communicate effectively.

    • Comfort using digital tools, online platforms, and web-based applications.

    • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify linguistic, factual, and contextual inconsistencies.

    • Good analytical and critical-thinking skills, particularly when evaluating content for accuracy and relevance.

    • Cultural awareness and an understanding of Arabic-speaking communities, communication styles, and regional language variations.

    • Ability to follow detailed guidelines, work independently, and deliver consistent, high-quality results.

    • Curiosity about artificial intelligence, language technologies, and how human feedback can improve AI systems.

    • Flexibility to participate in projects of varying durations and complexity, depending on your availability.

      • Previous experience in data annotation, content evaluation, translation, linguistics, prompt engineering, or AI training may be helpful, but project-specific requirements will vary.

      Benefits

Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.

Beide Hälften dieser Rolle drehen sich um dieselbe grundlegende Frage: Welche Systeme können unsere empfindlichste Infrastruktur erreichen und unter welchen Kontrollen. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Sicherheitsarchitektur unserer providerseitigen Infrastrukturschicht und bist Fachexperte (m/w/d) für die intern betriebenen KI-Plattformen und -Agenten. Dabei stellst Du sicher, dass diese in einem sicheren, verwalteten und auditierbaren Zustand laufen, anstatt sich schleichend als neue Klasse von privilegierten Zugriffen anzuhäufen.

Dies ist eine praxisnahe Expertenrolle. Du setzt Standards, prüfst Designs auf Herz und Nieren und arbeitest direkt mit Plattform- und Engineering-Teams über all unsere Marken hinweg zusammen, um diese umzusetzen.

Aufgabenbereich

Infrastruktursicherheit

  • Definieren und Pflegen von Sicherheitsarchitektur-Standards und Härtungs-Baselines für providerseitige Infrastruktur: Virtualisierungs- und Container-Plattformen, Control Planes und Bereitstellungssysteme, DNS, Mail-Infrastruktur sowie Backup- und Wiederherstellungssysteme.
  • Bewerten und Stärken der Mandantenisolierung über Shared-Hosting-, Virtualisierungs- und Container-Schichten hinweg sowie Treiben von Behebungsmaßnahmen mit den verantwortlichen Plattform-Teams.
  • Überprüfen von Infrastruktur-Designs und wesentlichen Änderungen auf Sicherheitsauswirkungen sowie Agieren als Eskalationsinstanz für Fragen zur Infrastruktursicherheit aus Plattform-, Cloud- und Marken-Engineering-Teams.
  • Reduzieren des Blast Radius auf den wichtigsten Pfaden: privilegierter Zugriff auf kundenorientierte Infrastruktur, administrative Segmentierung, Umgang mit Secrets und Wiederherstellungsintegrität — übersetzt in umsetzbare markenspezifische Implementierungspläne für unsere heterogenen Plattformen.
  • Unterstützen von Cyber Defense, Vulnerability Management und IT-Notfallmanagement mit Infrastruktur-Expertise bei Vorfällen und der Nachbereitung/Härtung.

Interne KI-Plattform- und Agentensicherheit

  • Verantwortung für die Sicherheitsarchitektur und Baseline-Standards für die intern betriebenen KI-Plattformen: Modell-Gateways und self-hosted Modelle, Agenten-Frameworks, Assistenten-Integrationen, Konnektoren und Retrieval-Pipelines über interne Daten.
  • Definieren und Durchsetzen, wie Agenten identifiziert, authentifiziert und autorisiert werden: Umgang mit nicht-menschlichen Identitäten, Credential- und Token-Management, Least-Privilege-Zugriff auf Tools und Systeme sowie Festlegung, wo autonomes Handeln ein Human-in-the-Loop erfordert.
