description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company.

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).


Functions of the Role

This senior position operates at the critical intersection of sub-Kelvin sub-system electronics and quantum processor architectures, directly addressing the interconnect bottleneck in scalable quantum computing systems. The role spans the full digital IC design cycle—including initial microarchitecture specification, RTL development, Verilog-AMS co-simulation, physical implementation (PnR/CTS), low-power synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), and full tape-out signoff. The ultimate objective is the realization of ultra-low-power, high-density cryogenic control ICs tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computing scale-out.


  • Position Title:  Senior Digital Designer (Front-End & Back-End)

  • Domain Focus:  Ultra-Low-Power Cryogenic CMOS (Cryo-CMOS) Digital Control Sub-circuits

  • Design Scope:  Full Lifecycle (RTL Development, AMS Co-Simulation, Physical Implementation, Low-Power Synthesis, and Tape-Out Signoff)

  • Core Chip Architecture Target: Cryogenic digital logic blocks operating at sub-Kelvin regimes (<4.2 K), 


Experience - Essentials

  • Education: Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.

  • Chip Design Experience: 5+ years of hands-on digital and mixed-signal IC design, demonstrating successful completion of at least 2 tape-outs on advanced semiconductor nodes 

  • Hardware Coding: Proficiency in Verilog and SystemVerilog for synthesizable RTL development and Verilog-AMS/SystemVerilog-Real-Math for mixed-signal co-simulation and testbench environments.

  • Design Tools: Proven proficiency with industry-standard EDA toolchains (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso/Innovus/Xcelium, Synopsys Design Compiler) for mixed-signal simulation, synthesis, and verification.

  • Physical Layout: Demonstrated capability in transforming RTL into GDSII/OASIS physical layouts, floorplanning, power grid synthesis, clock tree synthesis (CTS), multi-corner multi-mode static timing analysis (MCMM STA), and physical signoff (DRC/LVS/ERC).

  • Communication & Logic Design: Experience architecting high-speed serial interconnect protocols (e.g., custom SPI, AXI, SerDes) and complex finite-state machine (FSM) control logic.

  • Low Power & Thermal Management: Deep expertise in low-power dissipation techniques (clock gating, power gating, dynamic voltage scaling) within stringent thermal lift budgets of cryogenic cooling systems.


Experience - Desirable

  • Cryogenic CMOS Experience: Hands-on experience designing, modeling, or characterizing CMOS circuits at sub-4.2 K temperatures and understanding cryo-specific transistor behavior.
  • Mixed-Signal & AMS Interfaces: Direct integration of digital logic with precision analog/RF front-ends (ADCs, DACs, LNAs, AWGs) for qubit control and readout.
  • Quantum Architecture Awareness: Familiarity with quantum control interfaces, pulse generation, error correction, or cryogenic spin qubit electronics
  • Low-Power Verification & UPF/CPF: Proficiency in power-aware simulation using IEEE 1801 UPF/CPF, formal LEC, and power signoff tools (Voltus, PrimePower).
  • Advanced Process Nodes: Experience with sub-28nm nodes, with a strong preference for FD-SOI or FinFET technologies.
  • EDA Scripting & Automation: Strong scripting skills (TCL, Python) to automate synthesis, physical design, and verification flows.
  • DFT & Silicon Bring-Up: Practical knowledge of DFT insertion (Scan, MBIST) and post-silicon laboratory bring-up, testing, and debug.

You'll be accountable for every deployment we run, and be the senior escalation route, for our team and our customers, when something gets stuck.

You've done it by turning repeated human work and customer-specific work into product, built with Product and Engineering. Each plant now needs half the people it did when you joined.

Outcome – a grip on results. Before we start, every plant has agreed with us what success looks like and whose data counts. You've balanced the need to hit our timelines with the need to pass evaluations, pausing a plant that isn't ready rather than letting it fail, so every evaluation has passed first time. Outcome – customers who trust us at every level. Every plant has a clear owner, and an escalation route that solves problems before they reach our exec team. You've built a clean handover from Sales and a voice for Deployment in which plants we take on.

Outcome – post-sales solved. With our sales leader, you've set up how we run every plant after evaluation, and it works, with clear responsibilities mapped out.   • You notice early signs of trouble and raise them with urgency, and you use judgement to tell what needs action and what doesn't.

  • You're happy to travel to our plants worldwide, about a quarter of the time and more in your first few months: to build relationships with customer leaders, coach your team on site and learn how our plants run.

  • Automation - end-to-end pipelines that run without babysitting: classify, extract, propose, verify - humans review outcomes instead of doing the work by hand

description:
INDG is expanding the way high-volume visual content is produced: from CGI and 3D pipelines into AI-assisted image generation, editing, and content orchestration. This role exists to help turn generative AI from an experimental layer into a reliable production capability.

 

As a Generative-AI Artist (freelance), you will build and run image generation workflows that support real client production: fashion, sportswear, product imagery, talent visuals, campaign adaptations, and asset variation at scale. You will work inside the tension that defines this role: fast-moving AI models, production deadlines, visual realism, brand consistency, and systems that other people can actually use.

 

INDG has spent 20+ years building visual production systems for global brands. Grip extends that heritage into AI-orchestrated content production. Your work will help teams generate, edit, refine, and scale imagery while keeping outputs sharp enough for enterprise brand use.

 

 

What You Will Do

Build and Maintain Generative Image Workflows

Set up, configure, and troubleshoot custom ComfyUI workflows for image generation, image editing, inpainting, outpainting, upscaling, relighting, variation generation, and controlled composition.

You will connect models, nodes, prompts, masks, ControlNet inputs, LoRAs, reference images, and post-processing steps into repeatable workflows. The goal is not a one-off good image. The goal is a workflow that can produce consistent, usable outputs across many assets.

Apply AI to Production Content Problems

Use generative AI techniques against real production needs: adjusting apparel/footwear/accessories/equipment imagery, refining fashion/sportswear product shots, extending scenes, improving model consistency, generating controlled variations, or supporting creative teams with rapid image exploration.

You should understand that production images are judged on details: skin texture, garment fit, fabric behavior, seams, logos, lighting direction, pose plausibility, background continuity, and whether the image still feels brand-correct after generation.

Adapt Quickly as Models and Tools Change

Work confidently across diffusion-based models, LoRAs, ControlNet, IP-Adapter-style workflows, segmentation tools, inpainting models, outpainting methods, face and identity consistency techniques, and emerging image-generation systems.

You will test new models, identify where they improve or break the pipeline, and help the team decide when a tool is production-ready. You do not need every new release to be perfect. You need to know how to evaluate it, isolate failure modes, and translate it into a usable workflow.

Support a Pipeline Used by Artists and Production Teams

Document workflows clearly enough for artists, producers, and technical teams to reuse them. Package settings, prompts, node graphs, model dependencies, and output criteria in a way that reduces guesswork.

You will work with CGI artists, creative technologists, production leads, and platform teams to connect creative intent with operational execution. When something fails, you trace the system: model choice, conditioning input, prompt structure, mask quality, render reference, node configuration, or post-process step.


Who You Are

You live at the intersection of image-making and systems-building. You care about the final image, but you also care about the workflow that created it.

 

You Have

Hands-on experience building and maintaining ComfyUI workflows, or comparable node-based generative AI systems.

A strong working knowledge of current image-generation methods: diffusion models, LoRAs, ControlNet, inpainting, outpainting, image-to-image workflows, upscaling, masking, reference-based generation, and controlled variation.

Experience producing or refining commercial-quality imagery. Fashion, sportswear, product, talent, ecommerce, campaign adaptation, or CGI production experience is a strong plus.

 

You Think

Systems-first. A good prompt is useful; a repeatable workflow is better.

Automation-first. Manual fixes are acceptable only when they teach the pipeline what to solve next.

Visually. You can tell when an image fails because of lighting, anatomy, garment behavior, material response, identity drift, composition, or post-processing artifacts.

 

Your Skills Are

ComfyUI workflow construction, debugging, model loading, node graph organization, and dependency management.

Practical prompt engineering for controlled output, not prompt decoration.

Image evaluation for realism, consistency, brand fit, and production usability.

Comfort with fast tool changes, incomplete documentation, broken nodes, model conflicts, and solving problems directly.

 

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than two decades building CGI, 3D, and visual production systems for global brands. Grip now orchestrates AI workflows and production-grade outputs across that same visual heritage.

This freelance role is for someone who wants to work where generative AI meets real production pressure: brand consistency, scale, quality control, and images that need to hold up beyond a demo.

Belangrijk is dat je dit niet als IT-project benadert, maar kunt aantonen dat data en digitalisering daadwerkelijk resultaat hebben opgeleverd in de operatie en P&L.

title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations - Remote
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.


The Role

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

  • Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

  • Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

  • Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

  • Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives.   

  • Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.

The Challenge

We are seeking researchers who:

  • See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

  • Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

  • Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

  • Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.


It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning

  • Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities

  • Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently

  • Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity

  • Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights

  • Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques

  • History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI


Ideal Researcher Profile

An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.



1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations

Mastery of Core Concepts

Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.

Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways

Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.

Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing

Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.


2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation

Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks

Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.

Turning Theory into Practice

Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.

Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source

Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.


3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems

Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines

Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.

Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training

A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.


4. Hardware & Systems Understanding

Efficient Implementations at Scale

Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.

Real-Time & On-Device Constraints

SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.

Architectural & Optimization Details

Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.


5. Rigorous Experimental Design

Controlled Comparisons & Ablations

Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.

Multifold Evaluation Metrics

From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.

Stress Tests & Edge Cases

Whisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world complexities.



Summary

Overall, an ideal researcher in deep learning consistently demonstrates:

  • A solid grounding in theoretical and statistical principles

  • A talent for proposing and validating new algorithmic solutions

  • The capacity to orchestrate data pipelines that scale and reflect real-world diversity

  • Awareness of hardware constraints and system-level trade-offs for efficiency

  • Thorough and transparent experimental practices

These qualities surface across research on speech (Whisper, BASE TTS), language modeling (Scaling Laws, phi-3), specialized hardware (TPU, Transformers are SSMs), and new representation methods (VQ-VAE, FSQ, SoundStream). By balancing these attributes—rigorous math, innovative algorithms, large-scale data engineering, hardware-savvy optimizations, and reproducible experimentation—researchers can produce impactful, trustworthy advancements in foundational deep learning.




Foundational Papers

This job description was generated through analysis of the following papers:

  • Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (arXiv:2212.04356)

  • Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue (arXiv:2410.00037)

  • Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis (arXiv:2403.03206)

  • Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models (arXiv:2001.08361)

  • BASE TTS: Lessons from building a billion-parameter Text-to-Speech model on 100K hours of data (arXiv:2402.08093)

  • In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit (arXiv:1704.04760)

  • Neural Discrete Representation Learning (arXiv:1711.00937)

  • SoundStream: An End-to-End Neural Audio Codec (arXiv:2107.03312)

  • Finite Scalar Quantization: VQ-VAE Made Simple (arXiv:2309.15505)

  • Phi-3 Technical Report: A Highly Capable Language Model Locally on Your Phone (arXiv:2404.14219)

description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

<aside>
🎯

"You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

</aside>

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $75k-$150k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

  • a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

description:

Art: Vollzeit

Sales an Vertriebsteams in Enterprises ist die Champions League - und Bliro ist dein Ticket rein. Du verkaufst an Enterprise-Unternehmen, lernst von einem Team, das genau das schon macht, und wirst Teil einer Growth-Story.

About Bliro

Bei Bliro revolutionieren wir den Arbeitsalltag von Außendienstteams mithilfe von KI. 2.5 Millionen Außendienstler allein in Deutschland verlieren täglich Stunden an manuelle Nachbereitung. Bliro löst genau das - mit Transkription und den KI-Voice-Agents Vicky und Tim, die Kundengespräche vor-und nachbereiten, Besuchsberichte dokumentieren und das CRM in Echtzeit aktualisieren. Per Sprache wird so die gesamte Schreibtischarbeit automatisiert und der Außendienst gesteuert.

Schon heute vertrauen über 2.000 Unternehmen auf Bliro - darunter schnell wachsende Start-ups, etablierte Corporates und mittelständische Unternehmen (z.B. igus, Lanxess und Telefonica Deutschland). Unterstützt von Top-Investoren, suchen wir nun dich als Vollzeitmitglied im Bereich Account Executive (AE), um unser Wachstum weiter voranzutreiben.

Unser Sales Team bringt Erfahrung aus den schnellstwachsenden Software Unternehmen der Welt (Ex-Deel, Ex-Autodesk, Ex-Celonis) und eigenen Unternehmensgründungen mit!

👇 Sieh selbst, was du an Vertriebsteams verkaufen wirst:

🎯 Deine Aufgaben

Als Account Executive bei Bliro verantwortest du den gesamten Sales-Cycle - von der Demo bis zum Abschluss. Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unserem SDR-Team, das deinen Kalender mit qualifizierten Demos füllt, damit du dich auf das konzentrieren kannst, was du am besten kannst: Deals zu closen.

  1. Sales-Prozess führen und gewinnen

  • Du leitest Discovery Calls und maßgeschneiderte Produkt-Demos mit Mid-Market- und Enterprise-Prospects.

  • Du baust starke Beziehungen zu Key Stakeholdern und Entscheider:innen auf.

  • Du steuerst komplexe Sales-Cycles und verhandelst Verträge mit ACVs von 50k€+.

  1. Mit dem gesamten Go-to-Market-Team zusammenarbeiten

  • Du arbeitest eng mit den SDRs zusammen, die deine Termine buchen - für einen reibungslosen Handoff und enge Zusammenarbeit.

  • Arbeite eng mit dem Customer Success Team für reibungslose Handoffs sowie mit Growth zur Schärfung unserer GTM-Strategie.

  • Du teilst Feedback aus dem Feld, um unsere Roadmap mitzugestalten.

  1. Quota übertreffen und Wachstum vorantreiben

  • Du clost konsequent neues Business, um die ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen - und zu übertreffen.

  • Du baust deine Pipeline in Schlüsselbranchen und -regionen aus.

  • Du positionierst Bliro als vertrauenswürdigen Partner für Kunden, die ihre Vertriebsprozesse mit KI transformieren wollen.

🧠 Dein Profil

Wir suchen motivierte AEs, die für High-Touch-B2B-SaaS-Sales brennen und mit einem kategoriedefinierenden AI-Startup wachsen wollen.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge im Abschluss von Mid-Market- und Enterprise-SaaS-Deals (ACVs von 50k€ und mehr).

  • Erfahrung in der Verantwortung des gesamten Sales-Cycles - vom Erstgespräch bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag.

  • Exzellente Kommunikations- und Beziehungsfähigkeiten im Umgang mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern.

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Team-first-Mentalität.

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung mit direkter Exposure zu C-Level, Sales Leadern und IT - nicht nur komplexen Stakeholder-Settings im Allgemeinen.

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an den industriellen Mittelstand in DACH.

💡 Warum Bliro

🚀 Klarer Karrierepfad - kein Blindflug
Bei uns weißt du von Tag 1, wohin die Reise geht. Als AE übernimmst du von Anfang an echte Deals, echte Kunden und echte Verantwortung. Wer kontinuierlich seine Targets hitted, kann sich bei uns in Richtung Senior AE oder Sales Lead weiterentwickeln. Kein Versprechen ins Blaue, sondern ein klarer Plan.

💸 Vergütung + Extras, die sich sehen lassen können
Bei uns bekommst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt, einen variablen Bonus ohne Deckel, VSOPs, Deutschlandticket, Wellpass sowie Essen und Trinken im Office. Dein Einsatz wird direkt belohnt. Learning Budget? Haben wir. Sales-Library? Klar. Persönliches Coaching, das dich aufs nächste Level bringt? Auch dabei.

🌍 30+ Köpfe, 10+ Länder, ein Netzwerk

Außerdem bringt unser Team bringt Erfahrung aus den schnellstwachsenden Software-Unternehmen der Welt mit. title: Applied AI Engineer, Government, International
description:
About the Team

The mission of the Applied AI Engineering team is to enable the secure and impactful implementation of Agentic solutions. In this international Government role, you will deliver clearly scoped AI use cases with public-sector customers, from a mission need through hands-on implementation, architecture, evaluations, measurable adoption, and documented handoff. Account-aligned technical and commercial owners retain ongoing account ownership.

About the Role

We are looking for a driven solutions leader with a product mindset to partner with our international public-sector customers and ensure they achieve tangible value with GenAI. You will pair with government agencies, policymakers, and other public institutions to establish a GenAI strategy and identify the highest value applications. You’ll partner with their technical teams, subject matter experts, regional cloud providers, systems integrators, and implementation partners to move from prototype through production. You’ll design architectures using supported OpenAI technologies and approved services, with explicit data, inference, evaluation, and production-readiness boundaries. You will collaborate closely with regional Sales and Solutions Engineering, Global Affairs, Applied Research, Product, Legal, and Security teams.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Deliver clearly scoped technical implementations with sophisticated international public-sector customers, serving as their hands-on engineering partner to build applications on supported model APIs, Codex, and other approved OpenAI technologies.

  • Work with senior customer stakeholders to identify the best applications of GenAI in their industry and to build/qualify a comprehensive backlog to support their AI roadmap.

  • Intervene directly to accelerate customer time to value through building hands-on prototypes and/or by delivering impactful strategic guidance, often in collaboration with systems integrators and implementation partners.

  • Forge and manage relationships with our customers’ and implementation partners’ leadership and stakeholders to ensure the successful deployment and scale of their applications.

  • Contribute to our open-source developer and enterprise resources.

  • Scale the Applied AI Engineering function through sharing knowledge, codifying best practices, and publishing notebooks to our internal and external repositories.

  • Validate, synthesize, and deliver high-signal feedback to the Product, Engineering, and Research teams.

You will thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring substantial technical consulting or hands-on delivery experience with international public-sector or similarly regulated customers, bridging regional technical teams and senior stakeholders.

  • Have successfully led GenAI or traditional ML implementations for government agencies in close collaboration with systems integrators and implementation partners.

  • Understand network and cloud architecture, including on-premise deployments, and show practical judgment about privacy, data residency, model-inference location, sovereign or regulated environments, identity, procurement, and customer authorization.

  • Are an effective and polished communicator who can translate business and technical topics to all audiences, including cross-cultural communication with public-sector executives, regional delivery partners, and legal/security stakeholders.

  • Have industry experience in programming languages like Python, Go, or Typescript.

  • Own problems end-to-end and are willing to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to get the job done.

  • Have a humble attitude, an eagerness to help your colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team succeed.

  • Are an effective, high throughput operator who can drive multiple concurrent projects and prioritize ruthlessly.

  • Can work with stakeholders in the target region's business hours and travel when required for customer delivery.

  • Existing UK Developed Vetting (DV) clearance is strongly preferred, particularly for work with UK intelligence and defense customers.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. Joining a startup and scaling it into a global product is one of the most challenging and rewarding experiences a career can offer. If that sounds exciting to you, you’re in the right place.


The role

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our engineering team and play a major role in our technical leadership during a significant platform shift.

Ravio is moving from a traditional SaaS posture to a platform built around agents - parent agents fronting our compensation data, specialist agents underneath, durable workflows, an MCP-based tool layer, and an eval harness to maintain consistency. You’ll own architecture and technical design across the stack: the customer-facing web app, the agentic platform, and the shared infrastructure connecting them.

You’ll bring system design depth - the kind that holds up under load, failure, and coordination across services and teams. You’ll continue to raise the bar on code quality, reliability, and the technical decisions that shape what we ship.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role - leading technical decision-making and tackling the hardest problems we encounter. There are also upcoming opportunities to move into management as our company continues to grow, if you wish.


Requirements

  • 8+ years commercial engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership during platform shifts - owning architecture, driving decisions, raising the bar through code review and design review, especially where LLM assisted engineering has become the standard

  • System design depth as your headline strength. Concrete: durability and consistency under failure, multi-service orchestration, data platforms, performance and cost at scale, observability and ops fluency

  • Senior-level fluency in TypeScript and Node, comfortable across the backend (PostgreSQL, GraphQL or HTTP APIs, GCP-shaped infra)

Nice to have

  • Production experience with agentic systems - tool calling, multi-step orchestration, LLM evals.

  • MCP, Anthropic SDK, or other LLM platform work

  • Building developer platforms, internal SDKs, or framework-shaped surfaces

  • Eval-driven development, prompt engineering at scale, LLM-judge harnesses

  • React or another modern frontend framework

  • Frontend

    • Jest

    • Storybook + Chromatic

    • Mantine

    • GCP (Cloud Run)

  • Backend

    • Typescript

    • PostgreSQL

    • GraphQL Yoga

    • Jest

    • Auth0

  • AI / agentic platform

    • Temporal - durable workflow engine

    • MCP servers as the tool layer

    • AI gateway (Bifrost) for logging, routing, governance

  • All the other good stuff

    • GitHub Actions

    • Datadog

The opportunity at Ravio right now

From your perspective, there are three critical things to look for when evaluating this role: a company going places, a strong engineering culture, and a role that gives you a true opportunity to have impact as a technical leader.

Ultimately it’s for you to decide whether that’s true in our two-way street interview process. Here’s a summary of where we are right now and what you can expect as a starting point.

There’s a lot happening at Ravio right now. We’ve just raised our Series A led by tier 1 US investors Spark Capital, and have acquired the benchmarking business of our competitor - Compete. We’ve got new joiners starting almost every week, and we’re rapidly expanding outside of our core markets in Europe. We need you to help us maintain our velocity and continue to build a scalable org and product.

Our core benchmarking product is at product-market fit, and we have a couple of new modules in the 0-1 phase. Beyond the core product, we’re building Ravio’s agentic platform - parent agents fronting our compensation data with specialist agents underneath, durable workflows on Temporal, an MCP-based tool layer, and an eval harness to maintain consistency. It’s a platform engineering effort with the same care and rigour we apply to the rest of the product. A Staff engineer joining now would help shape the foundations of how Ravio’s product is built for the next phase.

We’d like to think Ravio is a great place to be a Staff engineer - we have technical leaders who know first hand the importance of creating space and focus for engineering teams to do their best work. And you’ll be working alongside many accomplished and world class teammates, who are energised by the work they do and have a high bar for themselves and their colleagues.

title: People Director
description:
Zibber groeit. In Nederland, België en Duitsland, en met verdere Europese ambities. Dat vraagt om een People Director die zorgt dat onze organisatie kan meegroeien: met stevige & mensgerichte leiders, de juiste mensen op de juiste plek, een high-performance cultuur en People-processen die ons helpen om beter en sneller te werken.

We zoeken een strategische en hands-on People leader die gelooft dat duurzame groei begint bij mensen. Iemand die oog heeft voor wat onze collega's en leiders nodig hebben om met Zibber mee te groeien, zich te ontwikkelen én met plezier goed werk te kunnen doen. Je verbindt die menselijke kant aan onze bedrijfsstrategie en kijkt verder dan wat vandaag nodig is. Zo bouw je aan de organisatie die Zibber de komende drie tot vijf jaar nodig heeft, zonder het ondernemerschap, de persoonlijke aandacht en de energie kwijt te raken die ons succesvol hebben gemaakt.

Over Zibber

Zibber helpt vastgoedprofessionals zoals makelaars, bedrijfsmakelaars, woningcorporaties en property managers om woningen en panden beter, sneller en professioneler in de markt te zetten. Dat doen we met vastgoedfotografie, video, plattegronden, 3D-laserscanning en meetrapporten.

Onze kracht zit in de combinatie van mensen, operatie en technologie. Met ons eigen platform MyZibber digitaliseren en automatiseren we een groot deel van het proces voor onze klanten. Technologie, data en AI spelen daarbij een steeds grotere rol in hoe we werken en groeien.

Met circa 250 collega's in Nederland, België en Duitsland zijn we marktleider in vastgoedmedia. Het overgrote deel van onze mensen werkt in het veld: bijna 200 collega's leveren dagelijks op locatie bij onze klanten. We zijn PE-backed en werken gericht op groei, professionalisering, schaalbaarheid en internationale expansie. People & Culture speelt daarin een sleutelrol.

De rol

Als People Director ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor People & Culture over heel Zibber: Nederland, België en Duitsland. Je bent onderdeel van het managementteam en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de CEO. De volgende fase vraagt om een grotere en meer strategische rol. 

Je belangrijkste opdracht is ervoor te zorgen dat Zibber én onze mensen klaar zijn voor de volgende groeifase. Je bouwt aan een omgeving waarin collega's zich gezien voelen, zich kunnen ontwikkelen en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Je helpt leiders om hun teams daarin mee te nemen en vertaalt onze bedrijfsstrategie naar een heldere People-agenda, zodat mensen, organisatie en ambities samen kunnen groeien.

Wat deze rol anders maakt dan een standaard People-rol: onze vraag is seizoensgebonden en beweegt mee met de woningmarkt, en onze organisatie is grotendeels een verspreide buitendienst. Capaciteitsplanning, de bijbehorende kostencyclus en on- en offboarding op grote schaal vormen de kern van je werk.

Je focus ligt op vier gebieden:

1.Organisatie en leiderschap

  • Je bent een gelijkwaardige en onafhankelijke gesprekspartner voor de CEO, het MT en de leidinggevenden op organisatiestructuur, leiderschap, verandering en organisatie-effectiviteit.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat structuur, rollen, governance en leiderschap de strategie ondersteunen, zodat de organisatie sneller en effectiever resultaten behaalt.

  • Je ontwikkelt de leiderschapscultuur verder en helpt managers sterke teams bouwen die groeien en leveren.

  • Je brengt een helder People-perspectief in, stelt vragen die de organisatie verder helpen en maakt met de board en het MT duidelijke keuzes.

  • Je onderhoudt de relatie met de medezeggenschap in Nederland, België en Duitsland en betrekt hen tijdig en constructief bij verandering.

2. Buitendienst, performance en talent

  • Je professionaliseert workforce planning voor een seizoensgebonden, verspreide buitendienst: capaciteitsplanning, high-volume recruitment, on- en offboarding op grote schaal en retentie in het veld.

  • Je stuurt actief op de kostenkant van die cyclus en maakt de formatie- en kostenimpact van People-beslissingen inzichtelijk.

  • Je zorgt voor gezond, veilig en duurzaam werken in het veld, en voor een goed mobiliteits- en leasevlootbeleid voor de buitendienst.

  • Je bouwt aan een cultuur waarin mensen weten wat er van hen verwacht wordt, elkaar feedback geven en ruimte krijgen om te groeien.

  • Je professionaliseert performance management, talentmanagement, succession planning en leiderschapsontwikkeling.

  • Je zorgt voor een sterke employee experience, een omgeving waarin mensen graag werken én goed presteren.

3. Schaalbare en toekomstbestendige People-infrastructuur

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat People-processen, systemen en governance eenvoudig, efficiënt en schaalbaar zijn.

  • Je richt onze flexibele schil en buitendienst arbeidsrechtelijk robuust en toekomstbestendig in, inclusief kwalificatievraagstukken rondom zelfstandigheid. Je voert hierop de regie en werkt samen met gespecialiseerde arbeidsrechtelijke adviseurs in de drie landen.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor compensation & benefits, arbeidsvoorwaarden en het People-budget.

  • Je maakt People-data inzichtelijk en gebruikt analytics voor betere beslissingen over formatie, verloop, engagement, recruitment en performance.

  • Je zet HR-tech, AI en automation slim in om de People-organisatie effectiever en schaalbaarder te maken.

4. Cultuur en change

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat Happiness, Keep it Simple en Get it Done zichtbaar blijven in hoe we werken, leidinggeven en besluiten nemen. Juist ook als de organisatie groter en internationaler wordt.

  • Je helpt de organisatie professionaliseren zonder onnodige bureaucratie.

  • Bij groei, integraties en veranderingen help je bewust bouwen aan één Zibber: met dezelfde uitgangspunten voor cultuur en leiderschap, maar met ruimte voor wat lokaal anders moet.

  • Je bouwt samen met Marketing aan onze employer value proposition en employer branding, voor twee verschillende arbeidsmarkten: de buitendienst en het kantoor- en technologietalent.

  • Je stuurt het People-team aan, ontwikkelt het verder en zorgt voor duidelijke rollen, eigenaarschap en hoge kwaliteit.

Leiderschap bij Zibber

Als People Director geef je zelf het voorbeeld. Je maakt complexiteit simpel, creëert duidelijkheid en geeft mensen eigenaarschap. Je combineert hoge standaarden met oprechte aandacht voor mensen.

Je creëert ruimte voor verschillende perspectieven en durft besluiten te nemen wanneer dat nodig is. Je brengt een onafhankelijk perspectief in, luistert naar andere inzichten en spreekt je uit wanneer dat nodig is. Je kijkt verder dan People & Culture, doorbreekt silo's en neemt met het MT verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat van Zibber als geheel.

Strategisch wanneer het kan. Handen uit de mouwen wanneer het moet.

Wat je krijgt

Je komt terecht in een club die hard werkt en net zo hard lacht. Happiness is niet voor niets een van onze kernwaarden: we nemen het werk serieus en onszelf wat minder. Verder krijg je:

  • Een ambitieus en informeel team met veel energie en humor, waar successen worden gevierd en een goede grap nooit ver weg is.

  • Een sleutelpositie op directieniveau binnen een snelgroeiende internationale organisatie, met een plek in het MT en directe samenwerking met de CEO.

  • Volledige ownership over de People & Culture-agenda en directe invloed op hoe Zibber zich de komende jaren organiseert.

  • Dynamische organisatie.  Je hebt gewerkt in een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie en je snapt hoe hoog tempo, verandering en schaal doorwerken op mensen, structuur en cultuur.

  • Flexibele schil & inzet.  Je hebt ervaring met het correct en toekomstbestendig inrichten van een flexibele schil of buitendienst, inclusief kwalificatievraagstukken rondom zelfstandigheid.

title: Senior System Engineer
description:
Als Senior System Engineer ben jij de schakel tussen techniek en klant. Jij zorgt ervoor dat de IT-omgevingen van onze klanten stabiel, veilig en toekomstbestendig blijven. Of het nu gaat om complexe cloudmigraties, netwerkarchitectuur of hardwarevervanging: jij overziet het geheel en zorgt dat alles soepel verloopt. 

  

Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s en klanten aan uiteenlopende IT-projecten, vaak op locatie. Jij houdt het overzicht, stuurt waar nodig bij en communiceert helder over de voortgang en keuzes die je maakt.

title: Accountmanager Silky Groene Sector Noord Oost Nederland & Limburg
description:
Accountmanager Silky Noord-Oost Nederland & Limburg

Ben jij een commercieel talent met een voorliefde voor de Tuin & Park sector? Bij De Wild krijg je de ruimte om ons dealernetwerk van vakhandelaars in Noord Oost-Nederland & Limburg verder uit te bouwen. Jouw missie? Onze topmerken GTM Professional, Silky en Okatsune tot de absolute marktleiders in jouw regio maken. Dit doe je door niet alleen te verkopen, maar door echt te laten zien wat onze gereedschappen kunnen tijdens demonstraties, beurzen en technische opleidingsdagen.

Hoe ziet jouw week eruit?

Je geniet van een gezonde balans tussen focus op kantoor en vrijheid op de weg:

  • Maandag: Je start de week op je (thuis)kantoor. Je verzorgt de administratie, plant je afspraken voor de komende week en werkt offertes uit.

  • Dinsdag t/m vrijdag: Je bent hét gezicht van De Wild. Je bent onderweg en stapt binnen bij klanten en prospects. Je voelt je thuis op de werkvloer van de vakhandel en spreekt de taal van de sector.

  • 1 x per kwartaal kom je bij elkaar met de directie, sales, marketing en engineering om samen de aanpak in de markt en alle innovaties en productontwikkelingen te bespreken. Uiteraard ben je tussendoor ook van harte welkom op kantoor in Roosendaal.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Accountmanager bij De Wild krijg je de volle verantwoordelijkheid over jouw eigen rayon. Je vindt de ideale balans (50/50) tussen het koesteren van bestaande relaties en het enthousiasmeren van nieuwe business.

  • Relatiebeheer & Acquisitie: Je onderhoudt intensief contact met onze dealers in Noord-Oost Nederland & Limburg

  • Productbeleving: Je geeft advies op maat en verzorgt overtuigende productdemonstraties.

  • Samenwerking: Je schakelt snel met de collega’s van het Benelux-sales team en Marketing om onze zichtbaarheid te vergroten.

  • Expertise: Je blijft op de hoogte van markttrends en vertaalt klantbehoeften naar passende oplossingen.


Dit ben jij

Wij zoeken een collega die spreekt vanuit passie en ervaring binnen de groene sector. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Groen DNA: Je hebt een afgeronde MBO-opleiding (niveau 3/4) in de groene sector of techniek (bijv. hovenier of boomverzorging).

  • Ervaring: Je hebt vlieguren gemaakt in de groene sector. Heb je daarnaast ervaring in een winkel of bij een vakhandelaar? Dan heb je bij ons een streepje voor!

  • Talent voor Sales: Je krijgt energie van het binnenhalen van nieuwe accounts en het uitbouwen van bestaande relaties.

  • Grenzeloos & Flexibel: Je werkt bij een internationaal bedrijf en het is fijn dat je je talen een beetje spreekt, bij voorkeur Engels en/of Duits. Dat je open staat om af en toe in een hotel te overnachten voor werk in Duitsland of bij (internationale) beurzen.

  • Praktisch ingesteld: Je bent in het bezit van rijbewijs BE en hebt technisch inzicht.

Dit bieden wij

Bij De Wild word je onderdeel van een warm familiebedrijf met een informele werksfeer. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om je werk naar eigen inzicht in te richten.

title: Senior Integrated Photonics Packaging Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

The future of AI computing is light, not electrons.

As Senior Integrated Photonics Packaging Engineer, you will sit at the very heart of Q.ANT’s photonic hardware R&D. You will research, develop, and demonstrate novel electrical and optical packaging concepts that bring our photonic integrated circuits (PICs) to their full performance potential. Rather than managing external suppliers to deliver off-the-shelf solutions, you will own the hands-on development of packaging architectures end-to-end - from first-principles design through prototyping, benchtop characterization, and validation. By bridging optical, electrical, and thermal domains, you will directly shape the performance, integrability, and scalability of our PIC-based systems.
At Q.ANT, we are building photonic processing systems that compute with light - delivering a scalable, energy-efficient alternative to transistor-based architectures for next-generation AI and high-performance computing.


Your Impact & Responsibilities

  • Drive Packaging Innovation: Conceive, build, and experimentally validate novel packaging prototypes and assembly methods for the co-integration of PICs with light sources, photodetectors, and high-speed analog electronics.
  • Lead Workstreams End-to-End: Lead packaging R&D workstreams from concept definition and experiment design to hands-on benchtop testing and documented knowledge transfer.
  • Solve First-Principles Engineering Challenges: Define packaging requirements and solve complex optical coupling, RF/microwave signal integrity, and thermal management challenges from a first-principles understanding.
  • Develop Coupling Schemes: Design, build, and measure advanced optical coupling schemes (e.g., edge coupling, grating coupling, lensed fiber,
    micro-lens arrays). 
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with PIC designers, systems engineers, and electronics teams to ensure packaging architectures are co-designed with device- and system-level constraints in mind.
  • Build Institutional Knowledge: Document process recipes, assembly procedures, design rules, and tolerance budgets to enable manufacturability assessments, repeatability, and IP generation.
  • Technical Supplier Alignment: Coordinate with external partners and suppliers for specialized materials or fabrication capabilities as the technical lead who specifies and validates rather than manages delivery.
  • Mentorship & Leadership: Mentor junior engineers and contribute to shaping the team’s overall packaging R&D roadmap.


Your profile

  • Education: Master’s or Ph.D. in Photonics, Optoelectronics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field (a Ph.D. with an experimental packaging or integration focus is strongly preferred).
  • Hands-on Experience: 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience in photonic/optoelectronic packaging, hybrid integration, or high-density interconnect development within a research institution, deep-tech startup, or advanced R&D environment.
  • Prototyping & Co-Integration Track Record: Proven experience conceiving, building, and characterizing novel packaging prototypes-specifically co-integrating PICs, laser sources/SOAs, photodetectors, and high-speed analog electronics.
  • Technical Depth: Deep understanding of optical alignment/coupling methods, flip-chip/wire bonding, die attach, hermetic encapsulation, RF signal integrity, and thermal management.
  • Lab & Tool Proficiency: Hands-on proficiency with optical characterization (insertion loss, far-field imaging, OLCR/OFDR, LIV testing) and electrical characterization tools (VNA, high-speed oscilloscopes). Familiarity with CAD layout tools and optical simulation software (e.g., Zemax, Lumerical) is a plus.
  • Mindset & Ownership: High degree of autonomy and creative problem-solving skills to navigate complex, competing constraints without off-the-shelf solutions. Strong self-leadership and collaboration skills.
  • Languages: Fluent in English; knowledge of German or another European language is a plus.


Why us?

  • Work on the leading edge: Photonic AI acceleration technologies that will define the next decade of computing - already validated in production HPC environments.
  • Make impact at scale: Help solve one of computing's biggest
    challenges - making growing demand in compute and sustainability go hand in hand.
  • Own your work from day one: Broad autonomy and decision authority with direct impact on product success, packaging baselines, and overall PIC module quality.
  • Fast-track your growth: Work on challenges with few industry
    precedents - every problem you solve becomes new institutional knowledge and potentially industry-defining IP. 
  • World-class team: Collaborate alongside a passionate, international, cross-functional team of experts in photonics, processor design, and AI systems.
  • Direct access to leadership: Work closely with the company's leaders within a transparent and fast-moving structure.
  • Collaborative culture: Innovative work environment that values technical excellence, open communication, and pragmatic problem-solving.
  • Be part of history: Join at the inflection point where photonic computing transitions from research to mainstream—your contributions will shape this transformation.

title: Senior Strategy Manager (all genders)
description:

tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 165 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

  • You help shape our long-term strategic roadmap and track whether it's working.
  • You dig into our market, competitors, and business performance to figure out what we should do next, then help make it happen with the teams involved.
  • You support senior leadership and the management board directly (e.g., preparing decision papers, board-level discussions), and acting as a trusted point of contact for board office topics.

You feel equally equipped to challenge a business plan from CFO stakeholders, as you are discussing a product concept with our CPO organization, or a G2M Approach with our CRO leadership.

  • Your toolkit: You communicate fluently in German and English, and thrive in interdisciplinary, international teams. You're fluent in PowerPoint and Excel, and comfortable turning complexity into a clear story.
  • Your passion: You're genuinely excited about tonies, our products, and our mission, and want to help shape a company on its way to become a Global Icon.





Why tonies?

  • Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders on our vision to bring the Toniebox into every child's room in the world.

  • Language Learning & Relaxation: Improve your communication skills with the language learning app Babbel and find relaxation through our access to the meditation app Calm.

  • Discounts: Benefit from attractive discounts on our entire range of tonies products.


Good to know:

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 165 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.


With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.


You as part of tonies:

Do you want to develop a product that is used worldwide? Do you have high standards for continuous discovery, usability and clean code? Do you challenge decisions and ideas against current requirements to ensure continuous improvement? If you answered “YES!” to these questions, we want to talk to you!

As a Senior Backend Engineer (m/f/d) you will join a talented product team dedicated to developing and maintaining the Toniecloud IoT services. Your focus will be on continuous discovery, usability, quality and security, ensuring a top-tier experience for our millions of users worldwide.

In the IoT and Control stream, you will play a central role in ensuring the seamless integration of our IoT products. You will empower our users by providing them with intuitive tools to set up and customize their devices to suit their unique needs.


Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

  • You take charge of developing and maintaining our Toniecloud IoT services, ensuring they meet the needs of millions of users
  • Play a key role in our Toniecloud ecosystem, which includes:
    • A robust django backend platform offering RESTful and GraphQL APIs
    • An IoT messaging stack that processes technical diagnostic data from millions of Tonieboxes around the globe
  • Maintain our commitment to reliability, ensuring our services are available 24/7, 365 days a year, and helping us achieve our 99,99% SLA
  • Collaborate within a cross-functional, stream-aligned team, where you’ll champion technical excellence to deliver seamless, always-on services. You’ll also work closely with the Product Manager and team members to ensure a fantastic user experience within the app (enabling parents to set up and configure their Tonieboxes and Tonies, enabling unlimited joy for our little listeners)


What we are looking for:

  • You have been a passionate software engineer for many years and are excited to continue improving your skills
  • Track record in building or maintaining backends for IoT products
  • You are fluent in at least two programming languages, one of them is Python – and you can quickly adapt to new languages when needed
  • Experience with Django is essential
  • Your code is lean, well-structured and easy to understand. You avoid unnecessary complexity from the outset and have a knack for solving complex problems with simple solutions
  • You are familiar with database systems (ideally PostgreSQL) and use ORMs thoughtfully and efficiently
  • Linux is your preferred environment and working with Git and GitLab is part of your daily routine
  • Your work style is characterized by agility, teamwork, independence and creativity, especially when exploring new solutions
  • You place great importance on automated tests, CI/CD, and observability
  • APIs (REST or GraphQL) are like your native language
  • You are comfortable communicating in English in a professional work environment
  • You must be currently based in Germany.
  • Last but not least: you are enthusiastic about our product and want to join us on our exciting journey!


Why tonies?

  • Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders on our vision to bring the Toniebox into every child's room in the world.

  • Come as you are: This applies not only to the dress code but also to everything else. Because only where you truly feel comfortable can you give your best.

  • Mobility: Choose the option that suits you best – a Deutschlandticket (public transport ticket) for unlimited mobility, a monthly contribution for an office parking space, a leasing bicycle, or a remote work subsidy.

  • Enhanced Security: Benefit from subsidies for company pension plans, occupational pension schemes, and occupational disability insurance.

  • Rest & Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of paid annual leave plus three additional days off such as Rosenmontag, Christmas Eve, and New Year's Eve. After one year of employment, you can also use up to 10 "toniecation days" (unpaid leave days).

  • Continuous Learning: Benefit from our internal and external training opportunities as well as an individual learning budget to continuously expand your knowledge.

  • Language Learning & Relaxation: Improve your communication skills with the language learning app Babbel and find relaxation through our access to the meditation app Calm.

  • Discounts: Benefit from attractive discounts on our entire range of tonies products.


Good to know:

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us. 

We look forward to hearing from you!
Florina Varga

You will have full oversight of risk across trading (spot and derivatives), treasury and investments, including exposures across CeFi and DeFi environments. This includes defining risk appetite, implementing advanced risk metrics and ensuring disciplined risk-taking across the organization.

Quantitative Risk Framework: Develop and maintain a quantitative risk framework grounded in modern risk theory (e.g. market, credit, liquidity and systemic risk modelling), leveraging concepts such as tail risk, extreme value theory, dependence structures and stress testing

Firm-wide Risk System Architecture: Co-design and implement the Firm-wide risk management system in close collaboration with the COO and CIO, including data architecture, risk aggregation layers, real-time monitoring capabilities and reporting infrastructure across all business lines.

Cross-Asset & Cross-Infrastructure Risk Integration: Build an integrated risk view across centralized and decentralized venues, covering exchange risk, counterparty risk, smart contract risk, collateral efficiency and liquidity fragmentation.

Advanced Risk Modelling & Metrics: Define and implement advanced risk metrics (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress scenarios, liquidity-adjusted risk, concentration risk) and ensure their consistent application across trading, treasury and investment activities.

Is plus: TradFi ↔ Crypto Risk Translation: Translate traditional financial risk methodologies into crypto-native environments, adapting models to account for 24/7 markets, fragmented liquidity, funding dynamics, on-chain transparency and new failure modes (e.g. oracle risk, protocol risk).

  • Strong drive and proactivity to continuously strengthen the risk management in a fast-growing financial institution

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning
